stories.title: People kept recording videos, engineer son died:Noida father says 80 rescuers arrived, not one entered water to save his son
stories.summary: 'Help me... help me... the son was screaming like this. People were making VIDEOS, no one was doing anything to save him. I scolded them. Still, no attempts were made. My son died needlessly.' This is the pain of Rajkumar Mehta, father of Noida engineer Yuvraj... The father watched his son, Yuvraj, drown in the car before his eyes. Rajkumar says there were 80 employees at the scene. No one got into the water. Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath is also angry about the accident. Noida Authority CEO Lokesh M. has been removed. The SIT has been given the responsibility to bring forward every face responsible for the accident. A report has been demanded within 5 days. Now, let's hear from Father Rajkumar about the negligence in the accident and rescue on the night of January 16. First read what happened on the night of the accident... 12:20 AM (Night) Call came, please save me, father says - I ran as soon as I heard Father Rajkumar says - Around 12:20 at night on Friday, I was lying on the bed. Suddenly, I got a call from my son, Yuvraj. He was about to come home, so I couldn't understand why he was calling me. I picked up the phone. A frightened voice was heard from the other end. He said- Papa...Papa I have fallen into the drain, I don't want to die. Please save me. After hearing this, I ran out in the clothes I was wearing. Before leaving the society, I typed a message and posted it on the society's group, so that help could be found. The drain my son mentioned was 200 meters away from our society. I ran to that drain. Here, I kept trying to search for my son in the thick fog and darkness for 30 minutes, shouting to get a response. Then I felt that I was searching in the wrong place. 12:30 PM Said to people making videos - Please save my son After this, I reached towards the road cut, where construction of a building was incomplete. A pit was dug here for the basement. Upon reaching there, I started shouting, hearing my voice, my son also screamed... save... save. After hearing the voice of "Help Me", I understood that my son had fallen here. I went a little further ahead, and through the fog I saw that the car was in the water and my son was lying on its roof. He was about 50 to 60 feet away from the road. He was slowly sinking. He kept turning his mobile phone light on and off so that those standing on the shore would know he was alive. I called Dial-112. It was around 12:30 at that time. I was watching him sink in front of me. There were other people there too, but no one was helping. Some people were making videos, I told them - Please don't make videos, help my son. Understand how the search operation was conducted 12:50 PM Crane reached 30 feet, and Yuvraj was 50 feet away Around 12:45 AM, police and a fire truck with Dial-112 arrived at the scene. By then, the fog had become dense. Visibility was almost zero. First, the police and fire team tried to rescue by throwing a rope. However, the rope was not reaching Yuvraj. Some police officers were saying the water is very cold, and how to get in. Some were saying there could be iron rods below the site. After this, a crane was called. But even the crane could not reach Yuvraj. It was only going up to 30-40 feet. No one present was trying to get into the water. The father said that the pit was probably 15 to 20 feet deep, so if divers were there, his son's life could have been saved. 1:45 PM SDRF called, but car submerged The SDRF team arrived at 1:15 AM. They also did not have adequate resources. Everyone was screaming save him, do something. Father says - I was ready to get into the water myself, but the police didn't let me go forward. Around 1:45 AM, Yuvraj's car was completely submerged in water. Yuvraj, who was lying on top of it, also disappeared into the water. We could only watch this happen. 80 personnel conducted search operation for 2 hours Around quarter to two, the NDRF team arrived. 30 personnel from SDRF and NDRF had already arrived. 50 personnel from the police and fire department were present there. About 80 people conducted the rescue and search operation. The team went into the water with the help of a searchlight, crane, and ladder. After 2 hours of effort, Yuvraj's body was recovered around 4:15. He was taken to the hospital, where doctors declared that he had stopped breathing. Fire department personnel who descended wearing life jackets were facing a lot of difficulty because there was no visibility. The hydraulic platform also could not help. The car could not be pulled out of the water. Father said - Authority is responsible, complaints about the spot were made, everyone kept sleeping Father Rajkumar Mehta blamed the Noida Authority for his son's death. He said - Society people had complained many times before. There are no lights or reflectors installed here; accidents can happen, but no arrangements were made. Even the drain that broke due to a truck collision 15 days ago was not repaired. Now read the situation from ground zero on January 19 Barricading was done, but no lights, reflectors were installed After understanding the full story of the accident from father Rajkumar Mehta, the Dainik Bhaskar team reached the ATS Le-Grandios turn near Noida Sector 150. This is where that deadly turn is, where the accident happened. We saw that barricading had been done at the place where the accident occurred. But no lights or reflectors were installed. A crowd had gathered, and we were told that 10 thousand people commute through here every day. Double basement dug and left incomplete We closely examined the spot, and the drainage boundary was broken. About 15 days ago, a truck had collided with this wall. It was not repaired. Ahead of this is the under-construction plot SC-02 of Sector-150. This plot belongs to MG Wish Town. Double basement work was done here and left incomplete. Water kept accumulating here due to drainage leakage. Due to water being filled for a long time, the soil here had become like a swamp. There was only 1 board here, which read - Sector 150. To understand the accident spot, we talked to many people there. It came to light that builder MZ Viztown Planners Private Limited and Lotus Green had gotten the map of this site approved by the authority. Commercial shops were to be built here. The basement was dug, but then work was stopped. Water filled up this same plot. Not just plots, most are in the same condition We started observing that there are societies on both sides of the road. Wherever empty plots were visible, the condition was the same. The plots were excavated and left as is. Most had water filled up to 30 to 40 feet. There was no drainage system at all. Half-finished flats were built with exposed rebars. No construction was taking place. Now read what people present at the scene think Vijay Mehrotra, who lives in Noida, says - A week ago, four or five of us friends were coming back from a party. We stopped right near the drain. We couldn't see where the road was. A few days ago, a truck also got stuck here. That's what broke the boundary. If the boundary hadn't been broken, this child wouldn't have gone inside, would have stopped right here. The boundary wasn't repaired. Action, what happened... Knowledge Park Police filed a case against 2 builder companies, MJ Vistaown and Lotus Green, on January 18. Father Rajkumar Mehta has filed the complaint. FIR has been registered against builders under these sections- After this incident, 2 events occurred on the evening of January 19- First. Authority CEO removed Junior Engineer Noida Authority Chief Executive Officer (CEO) Lokesh M. terminated the services of Junior Engineer Naveen Kumar with immediate effect. Show cause notices were issued to concerned officers. All departments were asked to monitor security arrangements around under-construction projects in their areas. Second. Chief Minister removed the CEO himself Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath removed Chief Executive Officer (CEO) Lokesh M. He has not been given any charge for now. A 3-member SIT has been formed to investigate the incident. ADG Zone Meerut is the SIT chairman. The Divisional Commissioner of Meerut and the Chief Engineer PWD have also been included in the SIT. The SIT will investigate this matter within 5 days and submit its report to the CM. Now know what the police says... Police Commissioner says - FIR filed, investigation ongoing Dr. Rajiv Narayani, Police Commissioner (Law and Order), says - This incident is tragic. As soon as information was received, the fire brigade team went to the spot with all types of equipment. Rescue attempts were made. Final rescue was conducted by involving SDRF. There was zero visibility at that time. But the boy could not be saved. The father has filed a complaint regarding this incident. An FIR has been registered.

Deputy CM Brijesh Pathak breaks down at Meerut poetry meet:Recalls days of poverty, says he arrived in Lucknow without shoes
stories.summary: At a poetry conference in Meerut, Uttar Pradesh Deputy Chief Minister Brijesh Pathak broke down on stage while recalling his struggles and life in poverty. An emotional video of his speech, lasting around one-and-a-half minutes, has gone viral on social media. Pathak had reached Meerut to attend the All India Poetry Conference organised on the 129th birth anniversary of Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose. While addressing the gathering, his voice trembled repeatedly and he paused several times, overwhelmed by emotion. “I came to Lucknow without shoes” Recalling his early days, Pathak said that when he first came to Lucknow, he did not even have proper footwear.“I had slippers, not shoes. In summer it was difficult to manage with slippers and in winter there were no shoes at all,” he said. “That is why, whenever I see a poor person suffering on the streets, it hurts me deeply. I have lived that pain myself.” The Deputy CM stressed that he does not see himself as a holder of power.“I do not consider myself a Deputy Chief Minister. I consider myself a servant of the poor,” he said, adding that he often feels unworthy of the position he occupies today. “I saw Baba Saheb as a father” Pathak also spoke about the influence of Baba Saheb on his life, saying that he looked up to him as a father figure.“My father is no longer here. When I heard about Baba Saheb, I felt he was like my father. I do not even consider myself worthy of standing where I am today,” he said emotionally. Memories of hardship and survival Sharing personal memories, the Deputy CM spoke about learning to live independently at a very young age.“I did not even know how to knead flour properly. Sometimes there was too much water, sometimes too much flour. At times, I would knead extra flour even when there was food for only one person,” he recalled. He added that his mother had given him a kerosene stove.“When I came to Lucknow, we used to cook rotis on that same stove. So I know what poverty truly is,” Pathak said, addressing the poets present and expressing respect for their contribution to the nation. The emotional speech drew loud applause from the audience, while the clip of Pathak breaking down continues to be widely shared across social media platforms.

stories.title: 'What will happen if Rahul Gandhi marries at 56?':Deputy CM Brajesh Pathak takes dig at opposition; adrress party workers during his visit to Hapur
stories.summary: Uttar Pradesh Deputy Chief Minister Brajesh Pathak triggered a political controversy after making sharp remarks on Congress leader Rahul Gandhi’s personal life while attacking dynastic politics in opposition parties. Addressing party workers during his visit to Hapur, Pathak said that both the Congress and the Samajwadi Party promote only family-based leadership. Taking a jibe at Rahul Gandhi, he remarked, “People know Rahul Gandhi, but he is not married. If he gets married at the age of 55–56, what will happen? Will he have children then? Is there any arrangement possible at this age?” Pathak further added sarcastically that in traditional Hindu belief, people of such age are advised to focus on spiritual life. A video of his remarks surfaced on Thursday and quickly went viral. ‘Dynasty will decide next leaders in Congress, Samajwadi Party’ The Deputy CM questioned who would lead Congress in the future if not members of the Gandhi family. He said that since Rahul Gandhi is unmarried, leadership would eventually pass on to Priyanka Gandhi’s children. Similarly, he claimed that in the Samajwadi Party, Akhilesh Yadav’s children would become the next leaders, leaving no chance for Akhilesh’s uncle or cousins. “Only sons and daughters will lead,” he said. Reference to Shiv Sena and NCP Pathak also cited examples of other regional parties, claiming that Shiv Sena declined due to “son obsession,” and that the Nationalist Congress Party (NCP) weakened after promoting family members over experienced leaders. Focus on administration and Health infrastructure Apart from political remarks, the Deputy CM reviewed administrative work in Hapur. He inspected the under-construction police lines and instructed officials to complete the work on time. During a visit to the district hospital, Pathak assured that there would be no shortage of doctors in Uttar Pradesh. He directed officials to conduct walk-in interviews at the district level and send selected candidates’ lists to the government for swift approvals and postings. Action promised in engineer death case Commenting on the recent death of an engineer in Greater Noida, Pathak said the government has constituted a Special Investigation Team (SIT). He assured strict action against anyone found guilty of negligence or deliberate wrongdoing, calling it a case that would set an example.

stories.title: 25 health workers fall ill after eating chola-rice in Lucknow:Doctors suspect food poisoning; trainees complain of vomiting and stomach pain
stories.summary: Around 25 Emergency Medical Technician (EMT) trainees suddenly fell ill after having dinner at the MC Saxena Training Centre in Lucknow. Several trainees complained of vomiting, diarrhoea and fever late on Wednesday night, following which they were rushed to hospitals. According to officials, 20 trainees have been admitted to the dengue ward of the SSB block at Balrampur Hospital, while five others are undergoing treatment at the TB Hospital in Thakurganj. Health deteriorated late Wednesday night The trainees told reporters that they were served chola-rice, roti and potato curry for dinner on Wednesday night. After around 10 pm, one by one, trainees began complaining of severe discomfort. Many started vomiting, had loose motions and developed fever. The centre’s officials were immediately informed. First aid and medicines were given on the spot. However, as there was no improvement, ambulances were called and the affected trainees were shifted to hospitals. Hospital confirms improvement in condition The director of Balrampur Hospital said information was received late Wednesday night about several people falling sick at the MC Saxena EMT Training Centre. Around a dozen trainees were first brought to the emergency ward and were admitted immediately. “Some more trainees were admitted on Thursday morning. At present, 18 trainees are being treated here. The good news is that everyone’s condition is improving and no one is critical,” the hospital said. Training conducted for 108 emergency service EMT training is currently underway at MCC Saxena College. The programme is conducted by EMRI, which runs the 108 emergency ambulance service.The training course lasts 40 days, and trainees reportedly pay Rs 45,000 to enrol. Trainees recount ordeal Shyamveer, a trainee from Kasganj, said his health worsened within an hour of eating dinner. “Some trainees developed very high fever, while others had vomiting and diarrhoea. When the medicine did not work, we were taken to Balrampur Hospital by ambulance,” he said, adding that he was feeling better now. Another trainee, Shivam, said that when everyone started falling sick, medicines were taken from the medical kit, but there was no relief. “Treatment is going on and I am feeling much better now,” he said. Doctors suspect food poisoning Dr Debasish Shukla, Medical Superintendent of Balrampur Hospital, said the trainees were first admitted to the emergency ward and later shifted to the ward for further treatment. “The symptoms indicate food poisoning. Some trainees are showing signs of dehydration. Their fever, blood pressure and electrolyte levels are being closely monitored,” he said. Dr Shukla added that the trainees would be discharged only after complete recovery.

Yogi Adityanath signals Sangeet Som to step back:CM makes remark while reviewing Sports university model during inspection visit in Meerut
stories.summary: Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath on Thursday inspected the model of the Major Dhyan Chand State Sports University in Meerut, where an awkward moment unfolded involving BJP leader Sangeet Som. While viewing the university model, the CM gestured towards Som and remarked, “Let the minister come forward,” signalling him to step back. Subsequently, Hastinapur MLA and Minister of State Dinesh Khatik was positioned beside the Chief Minister. Tension ahead of CM’s arrival About 30 minutes before the Chief Minister reached the university campus, Sangeet Som had a brief altercation with police personnel. During the exchange, he was heard saying, “You won’t listen unless you get your share,” expressing his displeasure. Officials later intervened and calmed the situation. The incident reportedly occurred when Som, a former MLA from Sardhana, was heading towards the Chief Minister’s programme and was stopped by police, leading to his outburst. Inspection of Sports university project Chief Minister Yogi’s helicopter landed at the Major Dhyan Chand State Sports University in Salawa at around 2 pm. He inspected the university campus and reviewed the project model. Addressing officials, the Chief Minister said that every university in the state would have a sports college. He added that the sports university in Meerut is expected to be completed by May 2026. Following the inspection, the Chief Minister held a review meeting with senior officials to assess the progress of the project. Hindu outfit leaders detained ahead of visit Ahead of the Chief Minister’s Meerut visit, police placed several leaders of Hindu organizations under preventive detention. Reacting to the move, Hindu activist Sachin Sirohi said they were being treated as if they belonged not to Hindu organizations but to terrorist groups. The Chief Minister’s visit remained under tight security throughout the day.

stories.title: UP BJP chief’s 20 km Kanpur roadshow:Flowers showered from bulldozer as party workers clash over welcome banners during grand event
stories.summary: Uttar Pradesh BJP state president Pankaj Chaudhary carried out a 20-kilometre-long roadshow in Kanpur on Thursday, marked by grand celebrations—and a brief clash among party workers over welcome banners. Clash over welcome banners During the roadshow, BJP workers got into a heated argument over the installation of banners at a stage set up in Jajmau. Initially, a banner of Assembly Speaker Satish Mahana was put up at the venue, but it was later covered with a banner of MLA Mahesh Trivedi. This triggered an exchange of words between supporters of both leaders, briefly creating tension. First visit to Kanpur as state president This was Pankaj Chaudhary’s first visit to Kanpur after becoming the BJP’s UP state president. Party workers welcomed him enthusiastically at multiple locations along the route. Grand welcome with bulldozers, cranes and flowers In a unique display, workers climbed onto bulldozers to shower flowers on the state president, while cranes were used to garland him. Chaudhary was also presented with a ceremonial mace (Gada) as a mark of respect. Welcome on water, land and air Pankaj Chaudhary boarded a boat on the Ganga river, where saffron-coloured balloons were released into the sky along with fishermen. BJP Kanpur–Bundelkhand region spokesperson Anoop Awasthi said the welcome was organised in an unusual manner—through water, land and air. He added that flower petals would also be showered using drones. Roadshow to conclude at Kanpur University The roadshow, which lasted nearly three hours, was scheduled to conclude at Chhatrapati Shahu Ji Maharaj University (CSJM University). In preparation for the event, hoardings were installed on both sides of the road from Jajmau to Kanpur University to welcome the new state president. Throughout the route, thousands of party workers lined the roads, waving BJP flags and raising slogans in support of the leadership.

stories.title: Amit Shah and Ramdev touch each other’s feet in Haridwar:HM inaugurates hospital with CM Dhami; protesting Cong workers detained
stories.summary: Union Home Minister Amit Shah arrived in Uttarakhand on Thursday for a two-day visit marked by religious, cultural and official engagements. During his visit to Haridwar, Shah shared a moment of traditional respect with yoga guru Baba Ramdev, as both touched each other’s feet. Patanjali Director Acharya Balkrishna also paid respect by touching Amit Shah’s feet. Shah and Dhami reach Patanjali Yogapeeth Earlier in the day, Amit Shah, accompanied by Uttarakhand CM Pushkar Singh Dhami, reached the Patanjali Yogpeeth campus at Maharishi Dayanand Gram. There, he inaugurated the Patanjali Emergency and Critical Care Hospital, aimed at strengthening healthcare facilities in the region. Shah attends birth centenary celebrations Following the inauguration, Shah attended the birth centenary celebrations of Maa Bhagwati Devi Sharma and the Akhand Deep Centenary Year programme for 2026 at Kankhal. He later visited Niranjani Akhada, where he performed worship at the Hanuman temple, sought blessings from saints and paid respects to Maa Ganga. The Akhada honoured him with brass idols of Maa Ganga and Hanuman Ji. A day earlier, on Wednesday, the Union Home Minister had participated in a programme organised by Gita Press in Rishikesh. See 2 pictures Youth Congress protest, workers detained Meanwhile, Youth Congress workers attempted to protest against Amit Shah’s visit by planning to show black flags on Thursday. Protesters sat on roads holding posters and banners. However, police intervened and detained the Congress workers, who were forcibly taken into police vehicles. Four major points highlighted by Amit Shah Haridwar described as centre of faith and spirituality Amit Shah said that Haridwar is the land of Kumbh, penance of the Saptarishis and spiritual awakening. He noted that under the Gayatri Parivar movement, more than 15 crore people are advancing on the spiritual path. Describing the Akhand Jyoti centenary celebrations, he said the region reflects a confluence of faith, spirituality and culture. He added that Pandit Shriram Sharma Acharya courageously challenged rigid traditions, including restrictions on women chanting the Gayatri mantra, thereby opening the path of spiritual welfare for all, regardless of caste, community or gender. After completing his engagements, Amit Shah returned to Delhi. Five key points highlighted by CM Pushkar Singh Dhami

stories.title: Brahmins shave heads to show support for Avimukteshwaranand:Poster outside Lucknow Samajwadi Party office warns, 'India won’t tolerate insult to Shankaracharya'
stories.summary: A controversy following a confrontation between Shankaracharya Swami Avimukteshwaranand and the administration during the Magh Mela in Prayagraj has intensified, triggering protests across several states and dividing the saint community into two camps. Demonstrations have been reported from Uttarakhand, Madhya Pradesh, Chhattisgarh and Uttar Pradesh, with political parties—particularly the Samajwadi Party (SP) and the Congress—openly extending support to the seer. Brahmins shave heads in protest in Haridwar In Haridwar, Uttarakhand, three members of the Brahmin community shaved their heads to register protest against the alleged mistreatment of Swami Avimukteshwaranand. Several Congress leaders also joined the demonstration. Among those who performed the head-shaving ritual was Ashok Sharma, husband of former Haridwar mayor Anita Sharma. He accused the government of arrogance and said authorities should have respectfully engaged with the Shankaracharya instead of humiliating him. “Brahmins are being subjected to oppression,” Sharma alleged. See 4 pictures of the protest Samajwadi Party comes out in open support The Samajwadi Party has openly backed Avimukteshwaranand. Posters were put up outside the Samajwadi Party office in Lucknow stating, “Hindustan will not tolerate the insult of the Shankaracharya.” The posters were installed by Ashutosh Singh, former secretary of the Ssamajwadi Party Yuvjan Sabha. Leader of Opposition in the Uttar Pradesh Assembly, Mata Prasad Pandey, also met Avimukteshwaranand and criticised the government, saying it speaks of Sanatan Dharma but remains silent when a saint is insulted. Protests in Madhya Pradesh and Chhattisgarh Madhya Pradesh: In Jabalpur, Youth Congress workers burned an effigy of the Uttar Pradesh government and raised slogans. Congress leaders said the insult of Avimukteshwaranand would not be tolerated and accused the government of discriminatory treatment towards saints. Chhattisgarh: In Raipur, Congress workers staged a sit-in protest, alleging that the Shankaracharya was deliberately stopped from taking a holy dip at the Sangam during the Magh Mela and was subjected to misbehaviour. They termed the issue one of religious freedom and respect for saints, not merely crowd control. Akhara Parishad’s stand From Ujjain, Harigiri Maharaj, General Secretary of the Akhil Bharatiya Akhara Parishad, said tradition dictates that all 13 akharas together confer recognition. “When society and the akharas together honour Avimukteshwaranand, only then can he be considered the Shankaracharya of the entire community,” he said. What happened on Mauni Amavasya On January 18, during Mauni Amavasya at the Magh Mela, Swami Avimukteshwaranand was heading towards the Sangam for a ceremonial bath in a palanquin. Police stopped him and asked him to proceed on foot. This led to a scuffle between police personnel and his disciples. Angered by the incident, Avimukteshwaranand staged a sit-in protest outside his camp and did not perform the ritual bath that day. Since then, tensions between the seer and the Mela administration have continued to escalate. The administration has issued two notices to him so far. Meanwhile, the controversy has visibly divided the saint community, with differing views emerging over the incident and its handling by authorities.

stories.title: Life imprisonment for 3 including tuition teacher, boyfriend in Kanpur:Businessman's son kidnapped and murdered; 30 lakh ransom was demanded
stories.summary: A court in Kanpur has sentenced three people to life imprisonment in the Kushagra murder case. The convicts include the boy’s tuition teacher, her boyfriend and his friend. However, Kushagra’s mother Sunita said she is not satisfied with the punishment and wants the death penalty for all three. She said the accused strangled her son to death and should be punished in the same way. She added that the convicts showed no regret and are cruel people. Kushagra’s uncle also expressed anger over the verdict. He said the family has suffered for two and a half years while fighting the case and will approach the High Court to seek capital punishment. He said only then will Kushagra’s soul find peace. The court had convicted tuition teacher Rachita Vats, her lover Prabhat Shukla and his friend Aryan, also known as Shiva, on Tuesday. According to the court, the three kidnapped Kushagra and killed him for a ransom of ₹30 lakh. Kushagra, a high school student, was murdered on October 30, 2023. During the trial, the prosecution presented statements from 14 witnesses. 600-page charge sheet, 240 pages of cross-examination ADGC Bhaskar Mishra stated that the police had filed a 600-page charge sheet in the case. The prosecution presented 14 witnesses in court. During the trial, 240 pages of cross-examination took place, and 42 documents were proven in court. Additionally, the police recovered 112 items related to the incident. CCTV footage was also shown in court, where Prabhat and Kushagra were seen entering the room. Prabhat and Aryan were captured while dropping the 30 lakh ransom letter, whereas at the time of the incident, Aryan was seen loitering outside Prabhat's house. In the statement under Section 313, Rachita stated Prabhat was her lover, and Prabhat also stated Rachita was his lover. 134 hearings held in 711 days Senior advocate Kamlesh Pathak, on behalf of the prosecution, stated that the file was sent to the Sessions Court on February 9, 2024. Charges were framed against the accused on May 3. The first date for hearing fell in the same month. In the Sessions Court, 134 hearings were held in 711 days, and the accused were convicted. On Thursday, the sentence was pronounced in the 135th hearing. 1.) Prabhat said - The ransom money was to buy a Swift Dzire car Rachita's lover Prabhat said - My friendship with Rachita started in the year 2017. At that time, Rachita used to tutor Kushagra. It was through Rachita that I met Kushagra and his family. I went to Kushagra's house two-three times with Rachita. 15 days before the kidnapping, Rachita took me to Kushagra's house as per the plan, where I met his mother Sonia Kanodia. Then, in conversation, I gathered information from Kushagra about his coaching commute. Seeing the lifestyle at Kushagra's house and his sister's program, I understood that these people have a lot of money. If I kidnap Kushagra, we will get a good amount of money. With that money, I will buy a Swift Dzire and marry Rachita, living a proper life. I made the plan for Kushagra's kidnapping with my friend Aryan and Rachita on October 22, 2023, at Central Park in Gumti. On October 25, I went with Aryan on a scooter to check all the routes as per the plan. I also told Aryan the entire plan, including how and to whom the ransom letter was to be given. Prabhat said - I strangled him with a rope After luring Kushagra and bringing him along, Aryan met me on the road outside the premises as per the plan. After this, I took Kushagra to a storeroom-like room. During this, I signaled Rachita. After that, she snatched Kushagra's mobile phone. We told him that we had kidnapped him for money. Now we will demand money from your family. During this, Kushagra said that we were playing a prank. When we told him that we were serious, he started to run away. We tried to stop him, but he didn't listen and started screaming. At this, I panicked. If someone heard the screaming, our plan would be ruined. At this, I strangled Kushagra with a coconut rope. To prevent him from making any sound, I stuffed a sheet into his mouth. I had brought the coconut rope a week ago from Dixit Hardware near Sant Nagar intersection. After Kushagra's death, I tied his hands and feet with the rope and made a video of it, then I sat in Bhandariya for a long time, then I took Rachita's scooter and went to throw the ransom letter. 2.) Rachita said - Prabhat Shukla wrote the ransom letter with his own hands Tuition teacher Rachita said - The three of us had planned Kushagra's kidnapping. After that, Prabhat went in front of the City Club to observe Kushagra during coaching hours and conducted a reconnaissance. On October 28, the three of us were together at Prabhat Shukla's house, where Prabhat Shukla wrote the ransom letter with his own hands. On October 30, as per the plan, Prabhat brought Kushagra to his house, where he had signaled me. I was ready that if Kushagra opened the gate and ran, Aryan and I would catch him. After the murder, Prabhat and Aryan, in a panic, put their respective mobiles, helmets, the shirts they wore on the day of the incident, Kushagra's mobile, bag, and helmet into a white sack and hid them somewhere in the bushes behind the Tezaab Mill Railway Colony. 3.) Aryan said - If we had kidnapped Kushagra and extorted money, our poverty would have been removed. Rachita and Prabhat's friend Aryan said - I had a deal with Prabhat that out of the money received, Prabhat would give me four lakh rupees. We had gathered information about Kushagra's coming and going to coaching. We thought that if we kidnapped Kushagra, our poverty would be removed. Sir, I also live in a rented room, I also needed money. After Kushagra's murder, I left with Rachita on Prabhat's scooter to deliver the ransom note. I covered the scooter's number plate with a vest. I went to Kushagra's apartment on the scooter, wearing a helmet and a mask. Prabhat had already gotten off before the apartment. Guard Rajendra removed the vest from the scooter's number plate and noted down the number. I had told Prabhat about this when I came back. After that, we both went near JK Temple on the scooter to drink tea. When I reached home, Kushagra's family, along with Rachita, were at Prabhat's house, inquiring about Kushagra. Story of murder captured in 43-minute footage Kushagra, the 16-year-old son of cloth merchant Manish Kanodia, a resident of Acharya Nagar, left home on October 30, 2023, at 4 PM on his scooter to go to Menon Coaching in Swaroop Nagar. On the way, he met Prabhat Shukla, the boyfriend of his tuition teacher Rachita Vats. There, Prabhat asked Kushagra for a lift, claiming his vehicle had broken down. He took Kushagra to his house in Indra Kuti Hata, Om Nagar. Kushagra and Prabhat were captured by the CCTV camera installed outside the compound. In the footage, Prabhat was walking ahead, while Kushagra was seen entering his store-like room from behind. Rachita was staying in the room next to it. Prabhat strangled Kushagra in the store-like room. During this, his friend Aryan alias Aryan was standing outside the room. This entire 43-minute incident was recorded on a CCTV camera, which proved to be crucial evidence in court.

stories.title: AI-generated obscene clips of 50 Hindu women exposed in Mirzapur:5 gym owners arrested; main accused shot in police encounter
stories.summary: A case involving the alleged blackmailing of Hindu women attending gyms and pressuring them into religious conversion has come to light in Mirzapur district. Police claim that gym owners and trainers trapped women, created obscene videos using AI technology, and then blackmailed them to force conversion. The alleged network was operating through five gyms in the city. Main Accused Arrested After Police Encounter The main accused and gym owner Farid Ahmad was arrested following a police encounter. He sustained a bullet injury in his left leg and is currently undergoing treatment in hospital. Police have sealed all five gyms linked to the case. So far, five people, including gym owners and trainers, have been arrested. Obscene videos and chat records involving around 50 women have been recovered. ASP City Nitesh Singh said cases have been registered against seven accused, including Farid Ahmad, under charges related to religious conversion. How the Encounter Took Place On Thursday, police received intelligence that Farid Ahmad was hiding in the Kharanja Fall area. When police raided the location, Farid allegedly opened fire. Police retaliated, during which he was shot in the leg. An illegal pistol and a mobile phone were recovered from his possession. He was immediately shifted to hospital. Five Gyms Allegedly Used as Network Hubs According to police, the gyms involved are: All five gyms are reportedly operated by members of the same family. SOG In-charge Rajeev Singh said: Zaheer’s elder brother Imran previously assisted with gym operations and is now involved in land plotting. A separate land dispute FIR is registered against him at Katra Kotwali. Zaheer’s father Irshad is a former Head Constable of the 39th Battalion PAC. Allegations of ‘Love Jihad’ and Blackmail In complaints filed at Kotwali Dehat Police Station, victims alleged that gym trainers befriended Hindu women under the pretext of fitness training. Later, they allegedly edited photos and videos using AI tools to create obscene material. Victims were then allegedly blackmailed and pressured into religious conversion. B-Fit Gym Victim’s Complaint A woman who attended B-Fit Gym stated that trainer Mohammad Sheikh Ali gained her trust during workouts and later trapped her in a false relationship. She alleged that: She further claimed that she was forced to wear a burqa, pray five times a day, taken to a shrine, made to recite religious verses, and converted against her will. On resisting, she was allegedly threatened with death and viral circulation of videos. Arrests and Expanding Investigation Following the complaint, SSP Soman Verma formed four special teams from: On January 21, trainers Mohammad Sheikh Ali and Faisal Khan were arrested. Mobile phone analysis later revealed links to Zaheer and Shadab, who were also arrested. Further investigation connected KGN-2 and Iron Fire gyms to the racket. Evidence of Blackmailing Over 50 Women ASP Nitesh Singh said both arrested trainers had earlier worked at KGN gyms for nearly two years before joining B-Fit two months ago. Police have found evidence suggesting blackmail of more than 50 women. Call Detail Records (CDR) of the accused over the past two years are being analysed to identify further victims and associates. Gym Funding Under Scanner Police are also probing the funding sources of the gyms. Despite trainers officially earning salaries of ₹10,000–15,000, they were found using expensive mobile phones, branded clothing and footwear. Authorities suspect financial backing from local businessmen and public representatives, and the funding trail is currently under investigation.

stories.title: Stray dogs attack girl, inflicting over 100 wounds:She was dragged and scratched for 10 minutes in Barabanki after leaving home to get milk
stories.summary: A 12-year-old girl was badly injured after being attacked by 6–7 stray dogs in Barabanki. The dogs bit and dragged her for about 10 minutes, leaving her with more than 100 bite wounds. The incident happened in Bakharia Mohalla of Nagar Panchayat Belhara. Hearing the girl’s screams, neighbours rushed out and chased the dogs away with sticks. The girl is in critical condition. After first treatment at the district hospital, doctors referred her to Lucknow. Doctors said she was given an anti-rabies injection but needs a strong dose. Attacked while going to get milk on Wednesday morning Father Pankaj Kumar said - his daughter Jyoti was going to the nearby shop to buy milk on Wednesday morning at 9 AM. Outside the lane, about 6-7 stray dogs surrounded her and attacked her. Due to the dog attack, the child fell to the ground. After this, the dogs pounced on her. They started tearing at her body. The dogs bit her on her hands, feet, back, and legs in over 100 places. The blood-soaked child kept screaming. Hearing her voice, neighbor Noor Hasan rushed to the spot. Some more people arrived. When everyone confronted the dogs with sticks, they left the child and ran away. The child was trembling with fear. Neighbors took the blood-soaked child to the hospital by auto-rickshaw. The family was informed over the phone. After primary treatment at CHC Fatehpur, considering Jyoti's serious condition, she was referred to Balrampur Hospital in Lucknow. Noor Hasan said - Chased away the dogs with a stick Noor Hasan said - When I reached the spot after hearing the noise, dogs were biting the child. Some dogs were dragging her, biting both her legs. I ran with a stick and then was able to save the child. I immediately took her to the hospital. Father Pankaj Kumar said - An anti-rabies dose has been administered at the CHC, but the child's condition remains serious. Doctors say that the child has more than 100 wounds all over her body. A higher potency anti-rabies vaccine will be needed, which is not available here. Father said - Daughter is writhing in pain The father said - My daughter is writhing in pain. There is no part of her body left where dogs haven't bitten her. She can neither lie down nor sit. She is trembling and crying. Pankaj says that stray dogs have been a menace in the area for a long time and such incidents happen daily. But the dogs are not being caught. After this incident, there is panic in the neighborhood. People are not letting their children leave the house alone. Doctor said - The child's condition is serious Dr. Deshraj of CHC Fatehpur said - The girl was brought in a serious condition. Dogs had bitten her body in several places. She was given first aid, but due to her serious condition, she has been referred to Lucknow. SDM Kartikeya said - A letter has been written to the Nagar Panchayat to catch stray dogs. Nodal officers have been appointed to monitor dogs around educational and medical institutions as per the Supreme Court's directives.

stories.title: Live-in partner murders field officer of finance company in UP:Stages suicide; personally takes body to hospital in Bijnor
stories.summary: Police have solved the murder of a finance company’s field officer in Bijnor. Hariom Singh (32) was allegedly killed by his live-in partner, Sheetal (26), with whom he had been in a relationship for two years. Both lived in the Lalta Building at Nehru Chowk. Police said that during interrogation, Sheetal revealed she became pregnant last month but suffered a miscarriage, after which disputes began between the two. Upset, she went to her parental home on January 15 and returned on January 18, when another argument broke out with Hariom, escalating into verbal abuse. During the argument, Hariom attempted to hang himself from a ceiling fan using a stool. Police said that in a fit of rage, Sheetal kicked the stool, leaving him hanging. Hariom struggled but died, while she allegedly did nothing to stop it. After his death, Sheetal took him to CHC Chandpur and informed his family that he had committed suicide. However, the family expressed suspicion and later, Hariom’s cousin lodged a case against her. Following the investigation, police exposed Sheetal’s role and arrested her within 72 hours. The accused, a Community Health Officer (CHO), is a resident of the Chandpur Kotwali area, about 40 km from the district headquarters. Suicide story fabricated, but truth revealed after brother's complaint Suicide version told to doctors and police Dr. Zaheer Ahmed of CHC Chandpur said that on the evening of January 18, the woman brought her lover to the hospital in a dead condition, with a ligature mark on his neck. The hospital immediately informed the police. The woman claimed that she had stepped out to buy some items and, on returning, found her lover hanging from the ceiling fan with a noose. Brother alleges murder over money dispute Hariom’s elder cousin, Vipin Bahadur Singh, accused Sheetal of murder. He said the two had been living in a live-in relationship for a long time and, according to Hariom’s friends, he bore Sheetal’s expenses. Vipin alleged that Sheetal’s role was suspicious and claimed she killed Hariom following a dispute over money. Truth revealed in 3 days Chandpur police station in-charge Anil Kumar said- Accused Sheetal admitted during interrogation that she had committed the murder in a fit of rage. She initially tried to prove the case as suicide. On the very first day, the deceased's family members had accused the woman of murder. After the complaint, mobile phone, technical evidence and interrogation, the whole truth came out. The accused woman has been arrested and presented in court.

stories.title: Avimukteshwaranad faces possible ban from Magh Mela:Admin issues second notice; CM says, 'Demons are trying to weaken Sanatan Dharma'
stories.summary: The confrontation between Shankaracharya Swami Avimukteshwaranand and the Magh Mela administration in Prayagraj has intensified. Within 48 hours, the administration issued a second notice to Avimukteshwaranand, raising questions over alleged misconduct on the day of Mauni Amavasya. The notice accuses Avimukteshwaranand of breaking a barrier on a pontoon bridge and forcibly attempting to enter a crowded area with a carriage, allegedly creating a stampede-like situation. The administration has asked why he should not be permanently banned from the Magh Mela. It has warned that if a satisfactory reply is not received within 24 hours, the land and facilities allotted to his institution will be withdrawn. Response from Avimukteshwaranand’s side Media in-charge Shailendra Yogiraj stated that the notice was pasted behind the camp on Wednesday at 7 pm, but was backdated to 18 January. Avimukteshwaranand sent a three-page reply to the Mela office on Thursday morning at 8 am. Yogi says, ‘No one has the right to disrupt traditions’ Meanwhile, without naming Avimukteshwaranand, Chief Minister Yogi said that no one has the right to disrupt traditions. He said there are many “Kaalnemis” who, under the guise of religion, are conspiring to weaken Sanatan Dharma, and that people must remain alert against such elements. He added that for a sanyasi, nothing is greater than religion and the nation. Questions raised and replies given First allegation: The administration claimed that Avimukteshwaranand broke the pontoon bridge barrier and attempted to reach the Sangam with a carriage without permission, disrupting crowd management. Reply: He alleged that certain officials deliberately created disorder and later shifted the blame onto him. He stated that CCTV footage reveals the truth and clarified that he does not own a carriage and was travelling in a palanquin. Second allegation: The administration objected to boards identifying him as Shankaracharya, claiming a Supreme Court stay on the title. Reply: Avimukteshwaranand said officials should refrain from such commentary, adding that his lawyer had already emailed a response on 20 January.

stories.title: Prayagraj aircraft crashes into pond, pilots rescued by locals:Rescuers say, 'Pilots were stuck in the swamp, pulled them out with the help of companions'
stories.summary: 'We were near our house in Malakraj Mohalla when suddenly an aircraft was seen descending rapidly. There was panic everywhere,' recalls Pankaj Sonkar of Prayagraj. 'I ran towards the railway line and, while crossing it, saw that the aircraft had crashed into the swamp of a pond.' According to Pankaj, moments after the crash, the pilots could be seen gesturing for help. 'I gathered courage, removed my clothes and jumped into the pond,' he says. 'I reached the aircraft, took care of the pilots, brought them out safely, and later washed their hands and feet at my hut.' Aircraft crashes in densely populated area The incident took place in Malakraj Mohalla, a densely populated locality in the heart of Prayagraj city. The aircraft crashed into a pond located behind KP College. Schools and residential colonies are situated close to the site, and the Magh Mela area is around 3 km away. An Indian Air Force microlight training aircraft crashed here on Wednesday afternoon at around 12:20 pm. According to initial information, the aircraft developed a technical fault while flying and fell into the pond. As soon as the accident occurred, residents rushed to the spot. See pictures- Pilots ejected before impact Before the aircraft hit the pond, both pilots managed to eject using parachutes. However, they landed in the marshy area of the pond and became trapped in the swamp, which was covered with thick water hyacinths. Residents, showing presence of mind and courage, entered the pond to rescue them. Shortly afterwards, rescue teams arrived at the site. Personnel from the Army, Fire Brigade, SDRF and NDRF were deployed for rescue and safety operations. PRO Defence Wing Commander Debartho Dhar stated that the microlight aircraft suffered a technical malfunction shortly after taking off from Bamrauli Air Force Station at 12:15 pm. Pankaj Sonkar jumps into the pond first Pankaj Sonkar, who lives in a slum area of Malakraj Mohalla, was among the first to reach the site. Speaking to the Bhaskar team, he said, 'People were shouting and gathering near the pond. I saw two pilots stuck in the swamp and signalling for help with their hands.' He added that swimming was extremely difficult due to the dense water hyacinths, but he did not lose courage. 'They were very scared, but when they saw me, they felt relieved. Soon, Akash and some other local youths also arrived, and together we brought both pilots out safely.' ‘They hugged us after being rescued’ Pankaj said that once the pilots were brought out of the pond, they hugged their rescuers. 'I took them to my hut nearby and made them sit there. I arranged for their hands and feet to be washed. After that, they were taken away by officials,' he said. Videos and photos of Pankaj’s bravery have since gone viral on social media. Neighbours demand recognition for bravery Akash Sonkar, who also helped in the rescue, said that Pankaj risked his life to save the pilots. 'He reached the aircraft first. The government should do something for him,' Akash said. He also highlighted Pankaj’s difficult circumstances. 'He lives in a hut near the railway line. His father has passed away. He supports his mother, two sisters, his wife and children. The family is extremely poor.' School staff also joined rescue efforts Employees of Vidya Vahini School, Padam Singh and Ram Chander, also rushed to help. Padam Singh said they heard a loud sound like a rocket launch while on the school grounds. 'We saw the aircraft falling into the pond and the pilots signalling for help. Ram Chander and I jumped into the pond and assisted in the rescue,' he said. Court of inquiry ordered PRO Defence Wing Commander Debartho Dhar confirmed that a Court of Inquiry has been ordered. 'The investigation will focus on the technical failure, the pilot’s actions during the emergency landing, and data from aircraft meters, the black box and ATC recordings,' he said. The inquiry is expected to take about one month.

stories.title: Suspected terrorist flees during ATS raid in Meerut:Video shows terror plot claiming suicide attack on Indian army
stories.summary: Uzaid Qureshi, a Meerut resident, has been linked to terrorism, with UP ATS claiming he is skilled at brainwashing youth and connected to Al-Qaeda. He was active in a WhatsApp group planning a suicide (fidayeen) attack on the Indian Army. On January 18, ATS and Jammu Kashmir Police raided his house, but he was absent, leaving a notice behind. On returning home by scooter, Uzaid was stunned to see the notice and fled. A video of the incident surfaced on Wednesday. The team had taken Uzaid's two brothers into custody for questioning. However, they were released after interrogation. The investigating agency suspects that Uzaid is actively connected to Al-Qaeda's sleeper cell. See 3 pictures Full case details ATS secretly investigated Uzaid's background UP ATS and Jammu Kashmir Police secretly started investigating Uzaid's background. It was revealed that in November 2024, Uzaid had come to Jammu and Kashmir for work, where he contacted suspicious elements. Planning related to anti-national activities was shared Under which section is Ujaid booked? Accused of working as a sleeper cell Uzaid is active as a sleeper cell. It is also being said about him that he is adept at brainwashing. In such a situation, it is also possible that he has learned this work from a terrorist organization somewhere. Uzaid's father is a fruit commission agent who imports fruits from Jammu and sells them at the Meerut market. Uzaid also used to help his father in the fruit business. Significant step towards exposing the terrorist module ATS officials stated, This case is highly sensitive and is a significant step towards exposing the terrorist module. Locals are being questioned to gather information about Uzaid's whereabouts. Police have increased vigilance in the area and are keeping an eye on any suspicious activity.

stories.title: Mayawati to engage youth by putting nephew at frontline:BSP gears up for mission 2027; Akash to hold roadshows in 75 UP districts
stories.summary: The Bahujan Samaj Party (BSP) is planning roadshows and rallies in every district to strengthen its presence in Uttar Pradesh ahead of the 2027 assembly elections. Party chief national coordinator Akash Anand will lead the campaign, visiting each district to engage with party workers and the public. During this period, prominent leaders from other parties are also expected to join the BSP. From when will Akash Anand start visiting every district? What message does the party intend to convey by having Akash tour the entire state of UP before the assembly elections? Will Akash be the party's face in UP for the 2027 assembly elections? Read the full news Mayawati’s nephew Akash Anand is set to take an active role in Uttar Pradesh, with plans to hold rallies in all 75 districts starting late February or early March. Party sources say preparations have quietly begun, aiming to strengthen BSP’s ground ahead of the 2027 assembly elections. Mayawati hopes Akash’s statewide tour will help bring back youth who had joined Chandrashekhar Azad. Akash entered politics in 2017 Akash Anand was first seen with Mayawati at a public meeting in Saharanpur in 2017 and has been actively working for the BSP since. In 2019, he was appointed National Coordinator after the SP-BSP alliance ended following the Lok Sabha elections. He appeared as a star campaigner for the first time in the 2022 Himachal Assembly elections. Akash holds an MBA from London and is married to Dr. Pragya, daughter of former BSP Rajya Sabha member Ashok Siddharth. Why is BSP betting on Akash? Senior journalist Syed Qasim says Akash Anand is around 30 years old and young. BSP chief Mayawati’s appeal remains the highest in the state, but after her, BSP workers now want to see and hear Akash. In the 2024 Lok Sabha elections, his rallies in UP drew huge crowds, but after his controversial remarks on PM Modi, Mayawati clipped his wings. This led to misconceptions among BSP’s core voters that Mayawati was acting under BJP pressure, causing a triple setback for the party: Realizing the mistake, Mayawati is now correcting it by bringing Akash back and unofficially placing him in the party’s number-2 position. She aims to curb Chandrashekhar Azad’s growing popularity and strengthen Akash’s acceptance among BSP workers, ensuring no opposition when she eventually declares him her successor. Will Akash be the party's face in 2027? Senior journalist Ratanmani Lal says, 'Akash will be a prominent face, but Mayawati will remain the main leader. On her birthday, she told journalists that BSP workers are determined to make her UP CM for the fifth time, indicating that party and government reins, if formed, will stay with her. If her government comes to power, she plans to entrust key responsibilities to Akash and mentor him politically under her supervision. In BSP, Mayawati is the undisputed leader from numbers 1 to 10, and only after her do other leaders matter. Earlier, several leaders were considered important, but over time, she sidelined them, leaving no strong face except Akash. He will now take charge on the ground to boost the party, while Mayawati will occasionally visit to further strengthen the campaign.' Akash will tour all 75 districts of UP, holding rallies to energise ground-level workers and attract youth to the BSP. The campaign, modeled on Bihar’s Yuva Adhikar Yatra, will focus on connecting Dalits, Muslims, backward classes, and Brahmins. The success of rallies and meetings will be managed by brotherhood committees, BS-4 members, and the district organisation. Akash will also stay overnight with workers to engage with them directly. At a massive rally in Lucknow on Kanshiram’s death anniversary on October 9, 2025, Mayawati urged supporters, saying, 'Just as you stood with me, stand with Akash.' Akash active since Mayawati's birthday Akash Anand was in Lucknow on January 15 for Mayawati’s birthday and then went to Delhi to focus on strengthening the BSP organisation. He recently met state presidents from eight states, including Rajasthan, Haryana, Delhi, and Punjab, with his father Anand Kumar also present. Akash discussed expanding the party in election-bound states. Having campaigned actively in the Bihar elections, he will now be fully active in UP. Party sources say Vishwanath Pal, the state president and OBC face, may also join him in rallies and meetings. Rallies and meetings may start from the West According to party sources, Akash's rallies and meetings will start from Western UP. The party's core Jatav voters are highest in Western UP. Chandrashekhar is also active in Western UP. However, the district where Akash will go first has not been selected yet. Syed Qasim says - The party also wants to start Akash's rallies and meetings from the West to balance the Jatav and Muslim equations there. After this, the party's focus will be on the districts of Purvanchal. Here, to woo Brahmins, preparations are underway to include several local Brahmin leaders in the party in Akash's presence. Like in 2007, Mayawati wants to create a bouquet of social engineering by wooing backward classes, Brahmin, and Muslim voters. Through this, she hopes to easily conquer the 2027 assembly elections. BSP shrunk from 206 to 1 assembly seat BSP, which won 206 assembly seats in 2007, is now in a state where it has only one MLA in the assembly. In the 2022 assembly elections, BSP received 12.9 percent of the votes out of 15.2 crore voters in the state. It received a total of one crore 18 lakh 73 thousand 137 votes. The BSP's situation did not improve even in the 2024 Lok Sabha elections. The BSP, which won 10 seats in the 2019 Lok Sabha, could not even open its account this time. Its vote percentage fell from 19.43% in 2019 to 9.35%. This was almost 3 percent less than the assembly elections.

stories.title: Honour killing in Moradabad, sister lover murdered and buried:Both hacked to death with spade, bodies recovered from field behind temple
stories.summary: An honour killing case has surfaced in Moradabad, where a teacher and her lover were allegedly murdered by her three brothers. Both bodies were buried in a field behind the village temple and were exhumed by police on Wednesday night in the presence of a magistrate, after which they were sent for post-mortem. The case involves different communities. Based on a complaint filed by the lover’s father, police have registered an FIR against the teacher’s brothers. Two of the accused brothers have been taken into custody. The incident falls under the Pakbara police station area of Moradabad. Full case details Police ignored family's concerns Meanwhile, Armaan's family had been visiting the police station for the past three days in search of him. The family alleges that they had also filed a complaint, expressing apprehension of an untoward incident. However, the police ignored their concerns. Due to this procrastination by the police, the accused got three days to hide evidence. SSP Satpal Antil said, The boy and the girl were known to each other. After a thorough investigation, we suspected the girl's brothers. The police took the girl's two brothers into custody and interrogated them strictly, whereupon they confessed to the crime. They stated that they had murdered their sister and her lover. Both bodies were buried in a field behind the temple. Bodies found behind Neem Karauli Temple On Wednesday, teams from the SP Crime office, Pakbara Police, and police stations of Katghar, Majhola, Mugalpura, and Munda Pandey began excavation along the Gagan River. After several hours, the bodies of Armaan and Kajal were recovered from a pit near the Neem Karauli Temple. As the recovery became known, people from both communities gathered at the spot. In view of the situation, the CO Civil Lines called in additional police force along with PAC. The bodies were later sent for post-mortem. Village head Bablu Saini said, We don't know how long their affair had been going on? This evening, through the police, it was revealed that a complaint had also been filed by the family members of the deceased boy. Investigation revealed that both of them were murdered.

stories.title: A familiar Magh Mela announcement that guides lost people:Home Guard Vimal Sharma his team reuniting thousands since 23 years
stories.summary: Ae gaadi wale bhaiya. Ae babu ji. Aap apni gaadi peeche mod ke le aaiye. Udhar kahaan lekar ja rahe hain. Aap to padhe-likhe samajhdaar hain, babu ji. Gaadi peeche mod lijiye. Aa jaiye. Aapki seva mein vaahan stand bana hai.” Means--- 'Hey driver brother. Hey sir. Please turn your vehicle around and bring it back. Where are you taking it that way? You are educated and sensible sir. Turn the vehicle back. Come here. The vehicle stand is here at your service.' This voice that reaches you through loudspeakers at the Prayagraj Magh Mela is from Home Guard Vimal Kumar Sharma. Besides this, you must hear this voice throughout the day - such and such person is lost, wherever you are please come to Sangam Tower. Your brother is waiting for you. Vimal Kumar Sharma has been doing this work for the past 23 years. So far he has helped reunite over 2 lakh lost people with their families at the fair. Two other home guards also do this announcement work with him. However, Vimal remains the first choice of officials even today. Dainik Bhaskar team spoke with him. Let's find out... Started this social service 23 years ago Vimal Kumar Sharma is currently 56 years old. He is from Sonai village in the Meja area of Prayagraj.. As soon as the Magh Mela begins, he comes here. Vimal says, "In 2003, I was first called for announcements as people liked my conversation and language. People liked my speech and language. After this, I became the favorite of officials. Whenever the fair starts, officials say - Vimal Kumar, please reach your position." Vimal says, "I consider it my good fortune to help reunite people through announcements here. It's the blessing of Mother Ganga that I've been doing this for so long. I have 4-5 years of service left. I will continue doing this during this time, and even after I retire, I will come here selflessly (free of charge). I will keep doing the announcement work continuously. This work gives me peace." Reunited 8-9 thousand people on Mauni Amavasya During regular days at the Magh Mela, the number of people getting separated from their loved ones is less. But when there is a main bathing (mukhya snan) day, so many people get separated. More than 10 people's names are called every minute. Vimal explains, "On Mouni Amavasya, the announcements started from 3 AM in the morning. This process continued until 11 PM at night. That day, 8 to 9 thousand people were reunited. Yes, there were also 100-200 people whose relatives did not come to meet them. Our team dropped them off at the lost and found camp set up near the Hanuman temple." When we asked Vimal if he gets paid extra for this, he says - No, we don't get any money for this. But doing this work gives a lot of peace. Often small children get separated from their families, they are provided with snacks and water here. When no one comes, they are taken to the lost and found camp. The people there arrange for their stay. If still no one comes, they are given tickets for bus or train to their home. They also tell the bus conductor to drop them at their destination. Two other people also share the responsibility Besides Vimal, two more Samaritans do the announcement work. One of them is Home Guard Jagannath Patel, and the other is Suresh Chandra Bharti. Jagannath's house is also near Vimal's. Suresh Chandra is also from the Meja side. He is currently posted at Meja police station. For the past 4 years, he has been coming for announcements and learning from Vimal. Vimal says, "Both are our disciples. Both have now learned well and do the announcement work." We asked Vimal that many times you tell people to move their vehicles, to run away from there. Doesn't anyone mind? Vimal says - My voice is such that no one minds. The tone is always kept polite. Many times people turn their vehicles back and then go back with their vehicles while saying sorry-sorry. Sometimes even officials are stopped. They don't mind either, they immediately turn their vehicles back. While Vimal doesn't have exact figures to tell how many people he has helped reunite, he claims to have helped more than 2 lakh people meet at Sangam. The way Vimal is working, it seems he has helped reunite even more people in the last 23 years.

stories.title: Moving bus catches fire on Yamuna Expressway in Mathura:Passengers escape by jumping from windows and doors; vehicle destroyed completely
stories.summary: A sleeper bus travelling from Banda to Delhi caught fire on the Yamuna Expressway in Mathura, causing panic among passengers. As the fire broke out, chaos erupted inside the bus, with passengers screaming and jumping out through windows and doors to save their lives. 4 fire brigade vehicles brought the blaze under control after one and a half hours. The incident caused a traffic jam extending over two kilometres. Details of the incident The police stated that the accident occurred at 5:15 am on Thursday in the Raya police station area of the Yamuna Expressway. The sleeper bus (UP 90 AT 8837), travelling from Banda to Delhi, was carrying 30 passengers, including 10 women and 10 children. Station Officer Ravi Bhushan Sharma said that preliminary investigations indicate the fire may have been caused by a tyre bursting. All passengers were reported safe and were transferred to another bus to continue their journey. Photos of the incident- Passengers’ account The bus had departed from Banda for Delhi on the evening of 21 January. It was operated by two drivers and one conductor. Around 5 am, the bus reached the Raya police station area in Mathura. Passengers were asleep when they were suddenly awakened by a loud explosion near milestone 110 on the Yamuna Expressway. Smoke filled the bus, and passengers immediately realised the vehicle was on fire. The driver stopped the bus at the roadside and, along with the conductor, fled the scene. Some passengers exited through the doors, while others broke windows and jumped to safety. Flames were visible at the rear of the bus, and all passenger belongings inside were destroyed. Passenger Sonu Gupta, a resident of Kanpur who runs a car garage, described the incident: 'We were sitting in the bus since 11 pm, travelling to Delhi to collect some items. My friend Ejaz and I were onboard. Suddenly, near Mathura, the bus stopped, and a loud explosion occurred. Smoke and flames filled the bus, and passers-by immediately alerted the police.' Previous tragedy on the same expressway On 16 December, a similar tragic incident occurred on the Yamuna Expressway due to dense fog. Eight buses and three cars collided, resulting in a fire that killed 19 people. The incident was so horrific that the police collected the bodies in 17 plastic bags, and DNA tests were used to identify the victims. That accident took place near milestone 127 in the Baldev police station area. Rescue operations, involving 50 personnel from the police, fire brigade, and SDRF across nine police stations, took six hours. The expressway was blocked over a three-kilometre stretch, and a magistrate-led investigation was conducted under the supervision of ADM Amresh.

stories.title: Rain warning issued for 15 districts in UP, hail expected:Gusty winds likely, similar weather for next 3 days; mercury at 5.9°C
stories.summary: In UP, amid severe cold, alert has been issued for hail and rain in 15 districts today. Additionally, storm warnings have been issued for 41 districts. According to the weather department, there are chances of rain in western UP starting today, which will gradually affect central and eastern UP. Weather conditions to change Meanwhile, due to rain and snowfall in the hill states, the weather in the state will change again. For the past 2-3 days, there has been some relief from fog and cold across the state. Good sunshine is coming out during the day. In such conditions, with deteriorating weather in the hills, cold will show its effect once again. Talking about the last 24 hours, Muzaffarnagar was the coldest, where the night temperature was recorded at 5.9°C. After that, Bareilly was at 7.4°C, Kanpur and Ayodhya at 8°C each, and Meerut at 8.2°C. Weather scientist Atul Kumar Singh said- Due to the effect of western disturbance, there are signs of rain starting from western UP on the late evening or night of January 22. Widespread rain is likely in eastern UP on January 23. The weather may remain like this for 3 days. See the weather pictures- Know Today's Alert Why did the weather change, know here The effect of active western disturbance in northwest India is now clearly visible in Uttar Pradesh as well. Due to this, cloud movement has increased in many parts of the state. There has been a change in wind direction. Where easterly winds were blowing earlier, now westerly winds are taking their place. This has increased humidity in the atmosphere and conditions for rain are forming in some places. Rain beneficial for wheat-lentils According to agricultural experts, this rain is beneficial for wheat, lentils and chickpea crops, but may damage mustard and potato crops. stories.title: राज्यमंत्री ने दिए स्वच्छ एवं हरित विद्यालय पुरस्कार
stories.summary: कृषि शिक्षा और अनुसंधान राज्य मंत्री बलदेव सिंह औलख ने जनपद के 8 विद्यालयों को स्वच्छ एवं हरित विद्यालय रेटिंग पुरस्कार प्रदान किए। 2025-26 में जनपद के 1830 विद्यालयों ने आवेदन किया था, जिनमें से 8 विद्यालयों का चयन किया गया। पुरस्कार पाने वाले विद्यालयों में प्राथमिक विद्यालय चोखापुरी, कस्तूरबा गांधी विद्यालय, आदि शामिल हैं।

stories.title: डा. आलमगीर बीसलपुर में एमओआईसी रहेंगे
stories.summary: सरकारी अस्पताल में अधीक्षक पद को लेकर घमासान जारी है। सीएमओ ने लेखराज गंगवार को हटाकर डा. आलमगीर को नया अधीक्षक नियुक्त किया है। लेखराज को तीन माह पूर्व बीमारी के कारण हटाया गया था। डेंगू से एक मरीज की मौत की पुष्टि के बाद स्वास्थ्य विभाग ने जांच तेज कर दी है।

stories.title: Civil supplies officials seize 1.7 tonnes of PDS rice near Katpadi
उप्र दिवस पर उत्कृष्ट कार्य करने वाले हुए सम्मानित
stories.summary: गांधी प्रेक्षागृह में उत्तर प्रदेश स्थापना दिवस समारोह का आयोजन हुआ, जिसमें मंत्री बलदेव सिंह औलख, जिलाध्यक्ष संजीव प्रताप सिंह और डीएम ज्ञानेन्द्र सिंह ने भाग लिया। कार्यक्रम में सांस्कृतिक प्रस्तुतियों के साथ लाभार्थियों को प्रमाण पत्र और चाबी दी गई। कन्या जन्मोत्सव मनाया गया और शैक्षिक किट का वितरण किया गया।

stories.title: उल्लेखनीय कार्य करने पर प्रधान और सचिव किए गए सम्मानित
stories.summary: उत्तर प्रदेश स्थापना दिवस के अवसर पर, कृषि राज्यमंत्री बलदेव सिंह औलख ने पीलीभीत के ग्राम पंचायत नगरिया खुर्द कला के प्रधान विवेकानन्द सरकार और सचिव राजेश गौतम को उत्कृष्ट कार्य के लिए सम्मानित किया। इस कार्यक्रम में जिलाधिकारी ज्ञानेंद्र सिंह और अन्य अधिकारी भी उपस्थित रहे।

stories.title: समीक्षा बैठक में प्रारुप छह भरवाने के लिए जागरुकता पर दिया जोर
stories.summary: नायब तहसीलदार ऋषि दीक्षित ने विधानसभा सुपरवाइजरों के साथ एक समीक्षा बैठक की। इस बैठक में उन्होंने बीएलओ से अधिक से अधिक प्रारूप 6 फार्म भरवाने के लिए प्रेरित करने पर जोर दिया। उन्होंने सभी सुपरवाइजरों को निर्देश दिया कि वे रोज़ाना बीएलओ के संपर्क में रहें और समस्याओं की सूचना निर्वाचन कार्यालय को दें।

stories.title: मेधावी विद्यार्थियों और उत्कृष्ट प्रदर्शन करने वाले छात्र पुरस्कृत
stories.summary: राजकीय पॉलिटेक्निक में उत्तर प्रदेश स्थापना दिवस पर दीक्षांत समारोह आयोजित किया गया, जिसमें मेधावी छात्रों को सम्मानित किया गया। कार्यक्रम की मुख्य अतिथि डॉ. आस्था अग्रवाल ने छात्रों को नैतिक मूल्यों और तकनीकी शिक्षा के महत्व पर प्रकाश डाला। उत्तीर्ण विद्यार्थियों को डिप्लोमा प्रदान किए गए और विभिन्न प्रतियोगिताओं में उत्कृष्टता के लिए पुरस्कार दिए गए।

stories.title: छात्राओं ने पोस्टर बना और स्लोगन लिखकर बालिका सशक्तिकरण का दिया संदेश
stories.summary: राम लुभाई साहनी राजकीय महिला महाविद्यालय की छात्राओं ने सीएमओ कार्यालय में बालिका दिवस मनाया। कार्यक्रम में बालिका सशक्तिकरण, शिक्षा और स्वास्थ्य के प्रति जागरूकता का संदेश दिया गया। जिला अस्पताल की डॉक्टरों की टीम ने स्वास्थ्य जाँच और गंभीर बीमारियों की पहचान के विषय में जानकारी दी।

stories.title: सेंट जोसेफ स्कूल में कक्षा 12 के विद्यार्थियों को दी भावभीनी विदाई
stories.summary: सेंट जोसेफ स्कूल में कक्षा 11 के विद्यार्थियों ने कक्षा 12 के छात्रों के सम्मान में विदाई समारोह आयोजित किया। प्रबंधक फादर ग्रेगरी, प्रधानाचार्या सिस्टर रेम्या और अन्य ने दीप प्रज्वलित किया। छात्राओं ने डांस और भाषण के माध्यम से भावनाएँ व्यक्त की। सीनियर्स को स्मृति चिन्ह भेंट किए गए और अंत में आशीष दी गई।

stories.title: मार्ग को कब्जा मुक्त कराने के लिए ग्रामीणों ने किया प्रदर्शन
stories.summary: गांव नरायनपुर के ग्रामीणों ने अवैध कब्जे के खिलाफ प्रदर्शन किया। उन्होंने एसडीएम को शिकायत पत्र देकर बताया कि नरायनपुर से जनकापुर मार्ग पर खड़ंजा और नाला निर्माण होना है। खोदाई कार्य अवैध कब्जे के कारण नहीं हो पा रहा है। ग्रामीणों ने मार्ग को कब्जा मुक्त कराने की मांग की।

stories.title: बिहार के पूर्व मुख्यमंत्री कर्पूरी ठाकुर की जयंती मनाई गई
stories.summary: शहर कांग्रेस कार्यालय पर महान स्वतंत्रता संग्राम सेनानी कर्पूरी ठाकुर की जयंती मनाई गई। शहर अध्यक्ष श्रीकृष्ण ने दलित और पिछड़ों के लिए उनके संघर्ष की सराहना की। इस अवसर पर कई अन्य नेता और कार्यकर्ता भी उपस्थित रहे। सपा जिलाध्यक्ष ने भी कर्पूरी ठाकुर को नमन किया।

stories.title: राजकीय पॉलीटेक्निक में दीक्षांत समारोह में छात्रों को दिए प्रमाणपत्र
stories.summary: गुलाबटांडा के सरकारी पॉलीटेक्निक कॉलेज में 7वां दीक्षांत समारोह आयोजित हुआ। विधायक बाबूराम पासवान ने कार्यक्रम का शुभारंभ किया। छात्रों ने विज्ञान प्रदर्शनी में तकनीकी उपकरणों का प्रदर्शन किया। मेधावी छात्रों को डिप्लोमा और पुरस्कार दिए गए। मुख्य अतिथि ने तकनीकी शिक्षा की महत्वता पर जोर दिया।

stories.title: स्वर्ण समाज ने यूसीजी के विरोध में राष्ट्रपति को भेजा ज्ञापन
stories.summary: स्वर्ण आर्मी कार्यकर्ताओं ने यूसीजी अधिसूचना के विरोध में राष्ट्रपति को ज्ञापन दिया, जिसमें उन्होंने मांग की कि इसे तत्काल वापस लिया जाए। उनका कहना है कि यह अधिसूचना उच्च शिक्षा संस्थानों में जाति आधारित भेदभाव को रोकने के उद्देश्य से लाई गई है, लेकिन इससे संवैधानिक और विधिक प्रश्न उठते हैं।

stories.title: शिक्षा चौपाल में स्कूलों को निपुण बनाने की दिलाई गई शपथ
stories.summary: परिषदीय स्कूलों में आयोजित संकुल स्तरीय शिक्षा चौपाल में निपुण बनाने और बच्चों की शतप्रतिशत उपस्थिति बढ़ाने पर जोर दिया गया। शिक्षा चौपाल में निपुण भारत मिशन, दीक्षा ऐप, टीचर्स ऐप, और खेल सामग्री वितरण जैसे विषयों पर चर्चा की गई। सभी स्कूलों को निपुण बनाने की शपथ दिलाई गई।

stories.title: आभूषण लूटकांड में महिला समेत पांच डकैत चढ़े हत्थे
stories.summary: मऊ में पुलिस ने 13 जनवरी को हुए आभूषण लूटकांड के 11 दिन बाद पांच शातिर डकैतों को गिरफ्तार किया। लुटेरों के पास से 10 लाख रुपये मूल्य के आभूषण, पिस्टल और दो बाइक बरामद हुए। पुलिस ने 325 सीसी कैमरे की फुटेज के आधार पर लुटेरों तक पहुंच बनाई और फरार आरोपियों की तलाश जारी है।

stories.title: स्थापना दिवस के बारे में छात्र-छात्राओं को दी जानकारी
stories.summary: उपाधि महाविद्यालय में उत्तर प्रदेश स्थापना दिवस समारोह आयोजित किया गया। प्रोफेसर सत्य नारायण ने छात्रों को स्थापना दिवस के महत्व पर जानकारी दी। असिस्टेंट प्रोफेसर जितेंद्र नाथ मिश्र ने उत्तर प्रदेश के विभिन्न पहलुओं पर अपने विचार साझा किए। इस अवसर पर कई अन्य प्रोफेसरों ने भी विचार रखे।

stories.title: कुत्ते के काटने से भैंस में रेबीज, दूध पीने से परिवार पर खतरा, नौ सदस्यों को लगे इंजेक्शन

stories.title: लाइन में फाल्ट के चलते बंद रही बिजली सप्लाई
stories.summary: जिले के कई क्षेत्रों में बिजली सप्लाई फाल्ट के कारण बंद रही, जिससे लोगों को कठिनाइयों का सामना करना पड़ा। ककरा कलां विद्युत उपकेंद्र की 33 केवी लाइन में फाल्ट आया, जिससे बिजली ठप हो गई। इसके अलावा, जमौर के ग्रामीण फीडर में ब्रेकडाउन के कारण इकनौरा गांव की भी बिजली सप्लाई बाधित रही।

stories.title: Six held for kidnapping 13-month-old baby
27 से 31 जनवरी तक होंगी प्रयोगात्मक परीक्षा

stories.title: RSS youth wing training held in Azamgarh:Om Prakash Rajbhar distributes yellow sticks uniforms to 2500 workers during training camp in Azamgarh
stories.summary: UP minister and Suheldev Bharatiya Samaj Party (SBSP) national president Om Prakash Rajbhar has taken a major step to expand the Rashtriya Suheldev Sena (RSS), an organisation formed by his party. On Sunday, around 2,500 workers were given two-and-a-half-foot-long yellow sticks during a training programme held in Azamgarh. Participants were also provided with yellow uniforms of the organisation. Rajbhar referred to the sticks as “unlicensed weapons” and said the objective of the Rashtriya Suheldev Sena is to guide, train and create awareness among the youth so that they understand their rights and duties. First see 3 pictures of the event... What is the matter of stick distribution? In recent days, Om Prakash Rajbhar had announced the formation of a youth wing linked to the party, naming it Rashtriya Suheldev Sena (RSS). He had also spoken about providing “unlicensed weapons” to members of this force, which sparked widespread political discussion. Rajbhar arrived in Atraulia, Azamgarh, on Saturday and announced that RSS workers would be trained on Sunday and given unlicensed weapons. As a result, more than 2,500 young workers were called to the programme, where they received self-defence training under the supervision of retired Army officers. ‘Making society’s children aware’ Addressing the gathering, Rajbhar said that more than 60% of parents and children in society lack essential information. He added that many people are unaware of what kind of education is required for jobs in sectors such as education, police and health services. ‘Preparing RSS for the future’ Rajbhar said the Rashtriya Suheldev Sena would fight democratically against injustice, atrocities, corruption and exploitation. He added that members would also work in disaster situations and social problems through community service. He advised workers that if they come across an accident, they should help the injured reach the hospital instead of making videos. “This is humanity,” he said. Attack on Samajwadi Party During the programme, Rajbhar strongly criticised Samajwadi Party (SP) chief Akhilesh Yadav. He alleged that when Akhilesh Yadav was Chief Minister, jobs were given only to people of his own caste and that he did not acknowledge Ahilyabai Holkar during his tenure. On the beautification work at Manikarnika Ghat in Kashi, Rajbhar said the BJP is focused on development and that the legacy of Ahilyabai Holkar will endure, along with the installation of a grand statue. Rajbhar has earlier advised party workers to wear yellow scarves and approach police stations collectively to present their cases. Leaders and districts represented
