stories.title: Fresh currency notes sold openly on Kanpur roads:Bank staff accused of diverting wedding season cash bundles to black market for huge profits
stories.summary: 'A bundle of 100 fresh (new) 10 rupee notes will cost 1370 rupees... 20 rupee bundle is more expensive... it will cost 2480 rupees... 100 notes of 1 rupee bundle costs 2700 rupees... need 10 lakhs... need 5 lakhs... just make the payment... will give right now... You won't get new note bundles in the bank... bank officers deliver here... we buy from them by paying extra money...' The fresh notes that you should get from banks are being sold on UP roads after going black from the bank. The centre point is Kanpur's Ghantaghar area. Here, a bundle of 100 fresh 1-rupee notes is being sold for 2,700 rupees. This means for 1 US dollar, you will get only 3 fresh 1 rupee notes and 35 paise, while the dollar is worth 90 rupees. Similarly, fresh notes of 5, 10, and 20 rupees are being sold with extra charges. Actually, the wedding season has begun. In such a situation, the demand for crisp notes for the groom's garlands and other rituals has increased. When common people go to banks for fresh notes, they don't get them. Bank staff turn them away, saying there are no new notes. While the RBI (Reserve Bank of India) has strict orders that banks cannot refuse if fresh notes are available. How did fresh notes from RBI to banks end up being sold in the market? To find the answer to this question, Dainik Bhaskar's team conducted an investigation in Kanpur. Read the full revelation... Are there fresh notes in the market? Our investigation started with this question. We reached Shastri Nagar in Kanpur. Here, fresh notes are strung into garlands and sold. We met Ruby. She told us that if we take bundles of fresh notes from her, an extra charge of Rs 500 will be taken, because she also buys fresh notes at higher prices from shops in the Ghanta Ghar area. Reporter: Want to get a garland of notes made...? Ruby: Which one... 10 rupee or 20 rupee...? Reporter: How much will it cost for 10 rupee notes...? Ruby: Will you provide the bundle of notes... or do we need to arrange from our side...? Reporter: Tell me both options... Ruby: One garland uses 500 rupees worth of 10 rupee notes... how many notes do you want to use...? Reporter: Let's say... if we use a bundle of 1000 rupees (100 new notes) of 10 rupee notes then...? Ruby: If you provide the bundle, we'll charge 300 rupees for making it... Reporter: How much will it cost for two bundles...? Ruby: Then the total will be 1800 rupees... Reporter: Meaning... why so much... bundle of 1000 rupees... and 300 rupees charge... that's 1300 rupees... then why 1800 rupees...? Ruby: 500 rupees will be charged for fresh notes... Ruby's statement made it clear that an extra charge is taken in the name of fresh notes. Now we needed to find out where these new notes were being sold. To get this answer, we continued the conversation. They bring bundles of fresh notes bought in black market Reporter: Where do you get bundles of new notes from...? Ruby: We buy them in black market... Reporter: Where do you get bundles of new notes from...? Ruby: They are sold at Ghanta Ghar... we buy from there... Reporter: If we go there to buy, how much would it cost...? Ruby: You go there and find out... how much it costs... Reporter: Still, how much will it cost...? Ruby: The rates there change daily... rates change immediately... Reporter: Oh... there's no fixed rate there...? Ruby: No... there's no fixed rate... From here, we learned that bundles of fresh notes are being sold in black in Kanpur's Ghantaghar area. The rates keep changing here daily. Now let's go to the fresh notes market and understand the black marketing... After this, we reached Ghantaghar. There were shops along the road. Most shops had no names. The shops only had written, torn, old notes exchanged here. We reached Anil Brothers. Here we met the shopkeeper Vijay. Vijay said that bank employees come and sell us bundles of fresh notes, we add our percentage and sell them to you. Reporter: Uncle... we are wedding planners... need bundles of new notes... Vijay: Yes, you people must need it... You'll get it... Reporter: How much will one bundle of 10 rupee notes (100 notes) cost...? Vijay: The 10 rupee one... will cost you 1370 rupees... Reporter: How much will the 20 rupee one cost...? Vijay: The 20 rupee one is more expensive... will cost 2480 rupees (100 notes of 20 rupees). Reporter: Will I get a bundle of 1 rupee notes...? Vijay: Yes... You'll get everything here... Reporter: How much will a bundle of old 1 rupee notes (100 notes) cost...? Vijay: 1 rupee bundle... you'll get it for 1400 rupees (100 notes of 1 rupee)... and 5 rupee bundle will cost 1300 rupees (100 notes of 5 rupees)... Reporter: Will I also get bundles of 100 rupees and 50 rupees...? Vijay: 100 rupee bundle... you'll get it by paying 120 rupees extra... 50 rupee bundle will cost 5170 rupees (100 notes of 50 rupees)... From Vijay's words, it became clear that this market has all kinds of fresh notes. Just need to pay an extra price for all of them. Now we wanted to know how many fresh notes are here? How do they come here? When we talked to Vijay for the answer, he told us that you can get as many as you want. Bank employees themselves come and give them. 10 lakhs... 5 lakhs... you can get as many fresh notes as you want Vijay: Rates go up and down daily... less-more... Reporter: But we need it in bulk... meaning we need more... Vijay: How much more do you need... need 10 lakhs... need 5 lakhs... you'll get it now... just count the payment... Reporter: Actually... we went to the bank... submitted applications too... but they said... it's not available now... Vijay: You won't get bundles in the bank... You can get bundles of 100 rupees in the bank... Reporter: We went to the bank and got very troubled... but didn't get it... they said - will give when it comes... Vijay: They'll give when it comes... here commission will be charged... everything will be available... those b@$#@#$ give everything here... all bank officials give it here... no outsider gives it... when we are buying from bank people here by paying them more money, why would they give it to you...? The shopkeeper Vijay's words exposed their collusion with bank officials. Now we wanted to know how much bank officials earn in this black mailing? When we continued the conversation with Vijay, he said - Bank officials also earn good money. He also said that online transactions don't work here, all transactions are done in cash. Bank officials charge 3500 rupees extra for 1000 fresh notes Reporter: How much will bank officials get for 1 bundle (100 new notes)...? Vijay: If bank officials give you a bundle of fresh notes (10 bundles), they won't get anything... here they get Rs 350 for 1 bundle of 100 notes, meaning they get Rs 3500 extra for 1 bundle (10 bundles = 1000 new notes)... so why would they give it to you...? Reporter: Is this why they don't give it to us...? Vijay: Bank officials don't give it to customers... they all bring it here... Reporter: Well... Do you need to be informed in advance, or will it be available immediately...? Vijay: Will get it immediately... Tell me now... What all do you need... Will give right now... What will we do with so many notes... Reporter: We take wedding contracts... Client demands.... Vijay: Then what's the problem... Take 50 thousand extra from them... Everything will be arranged... Reporter: Okay... Will you accept online payment...? Vijay: Cash payment works here... Online doesn't work here... Reporter: It's used in garlands too, right...? Vijay: Garland... Jaymala... Notes are used in everything... Show the money... You'll get all the goods... Whatever you want... You'll get it... Vijay's words made it clear that there is no shortage of fresh notes in the market. Now we wanted to know which is the most expensive fresh note? In response, Vijay showed us a 1-rupee note. Said- these 100 notes will cost 2700 rupees. Old bundle of 1 rupee costs 1500 rupees, new bundle will cost 2700 rupees Reporter: For 1 rupee... will you get a bundle of old notes... or new notes...? Vijay: Both are available... old note bundle costs 1500 rupees... new note bundle costs 2700 rupees... Reporter: Hey... 2700 rupees... it will only have 100 notes in it, right...? Vijay: Yes... It will only have 100 notes... Reporter: Okay... now new ones won't be coming, right...? Vijay: The bank has no stock... clerks and officers keep everything at their homes... Reporter: Oh... bank clerks keep it at home...? Vijay: All officers keep it at their homes... when they're getting the money, why would they give it to anyone else...? Vijay claims that bank officers keep fresh notes at their homes instead of in banks. They are bringing these to the market and selling them. Now let's go to the bank, are fresh notes available here or not? After leaving the fresh notes market, we reached the bank. We wanted to know if fresh notes were available here or not. We reached HDFC Bank in Kalyanpur, Kanpur. Here we told the bank employee that there's a wedding at home and we need fresh notes. To this, the cashier said - Fresh notes are not available immediately. Come after January 14th with the wedding card and application. If bundles are available, we will give them. You won't get too many. We will try to give you one bundle. Meanwhile, when the Bhaskar team went to the State Bank of India Swaroop Nagar branch and demanded bundles of crisp notes, the bank employee said, go to your home branch and talk about it there. If bundles are available at the branch, you will get them. Banks are giving fresh notes, will take action if bank employees are selling notes in market Kanpur Lead Bank Manager Aditya Chandra said - So far, no such complaint has been received where bank employees were found selling fresh notes in the market. If such a case comes up, action will be taken against the bank employee. If customers demand fresh notes while withdrawing large amounts for weddings, bundles of new notes are provided. It depends on the rapport between the customer and the bank on how many fresh notes they receive.

stories.title: Assembly speakers meet in Lucknow for discussion:Om Birla says law-making is losing time and asks members to work faster and stay focused
stories.summary: The fourth conference of presiding officers is taking place in Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh. Many top political leaders are attending, including Governor Anandiben Patel, Lok Sabha Speaker Om Birla, and Rajya Sabha Deputy Chairman Harivansh. Prime Minister Narendra Modi sent a message for the event, which was read out during the conference. During the conference, Uttar Pradesh Assembly Speaker Satish Mahana, while delivering the inaugural address, highly praised Lok Sabha Speaker Om Birla. Mahana said, "Om Birla has created a new identity in the world with his parliamentary innovations." He reminded that this conference was held in Uttar Pradesh in 2015, and at his request, Om Birla has given UP this opportunity once again 'out of turn'. Mahana also praised Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath, who has completely changed the image of the state. He said, "Politics had been given a negative perception. It was believed that one who knows nothing becomes a leader, but now that perception has changed. Only one who knows everything becomes a leader." Parliamentary democracy is the most correct method of democracy Addressing the conference, Lok Sabha Speaker Om Birla said that the land of UP is the land of political consciousness. It is the largest state in the world, its population is more than the population of many countries in the world. Presiding officers from different states have come to this conference, whose responsibility is to enhance the dignity of the legislature. We should leave here with new energy, and the prestige and dignity of our democratic institutions should increase. The conference held in 2015 deliberated on making the assembly paperless, the use of IT, and ensuring that information about institutions reaches the public. Today, when we are holding this conference again, the outcome of that deliberation has been implemented everywhere. We face many challenges in maintaining public trust and authenticity, and this responsibility lies with the presiding officers as well as the public representatives. When we are elected, the public expects us to present their problems and needs in the house. The voice of an individual should reach the government, and whatever reaches the government should yield results. From this perspective, our institution works to make laws and deliberates on policies. We are the world's largest democracy. We have shown the world that parliamentary democracy is the most correct method of democracy. In this assembly, public representatives continuously discussed the vision of a developed India for 28 hours. Through such deliberation, we form shared policies. Consensus and dissent are the strengths of democracy; only when everyone's opinion comes forward can we establish a democratic system. We have introduced many innovations to increase public trust in democratic institutions. We formed parliamentary standing committees, made proceedings live, created rules and procedures, discussed with presiding officers of states within the framework of the constitution, and made changes while respecting the sanctity of the constitution. Our endeavor is to increase public trust in the legislature. Our work culture has been democratic. We will strive to incorporate everyone's suggestions and implement the best practices of the assembly. It is also the responsibility of the presiding officer to ensure everyone gets an opportunity if democracy is to be strengthened, the house must function. The longer the house functions, the better the discussions will be. In this very house, there have been discussions on sustainable development goals for a continuous 36 hours. It is in the house that the problems of the entire state, the voice of the people, and their opinions are heard. When we sit in the presiding officer's chair, we should treat everyone equally because the country watches us. Through this conference, we will make ourselves stronger and more accountable. The Governor said, if solutions are hindered, problems increase Addressing the conference, Governor Anandiben Patel said that this conference will give a new direction to legislative conduct. There should be no conflict here; our common goal is to strengthen constitutional institutions. Democracy has its own challenges important issues cannot be discussed due to disruptions, and when solutions are obstructed, problems increase. Legislative bodies are also playing a new role in society along with their traditional work. MLAs do not get a chance to speak for four or five days. When the Lok Sabha Speaker himself says that the House should run for more days, I hope that the House will run for more days. Deliberations will be held on strengthening the legislature Mahana emphasized the role of the Constitution, stating that it has fixed the accountability of the legislature. Today, doctors, engineers, retired IAS-IPS officers, and various professionals are present as members in the House. In the three-day session, there will be an in-depth discussion on strengthening the legislature, along with accountability towards the public and responsibilities towards the country and society. He expressed confidence that its echo, emanating from Uttar Pradesh, would reach all state assemblies of the country. Prime Minister Narendra Modi's message was a major attraction at the conference. Satish Mahana read it out, in which the PM emphasized the strengthening of democracy and the role of the legislature. Additionally, a short film based on the development of Uttar Pradesh was also screened. The film stated that under the leadership of Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath, the state has made unprecedented progress in every sector over the past nine years. UP has now become the 'growth engine' of the country's development, where significant progress has been made in investment, infrastructure, and social development. It is the government's duty to adhere to constitutional decorum Leader of Opposition Mata Prasad Pandey also addressed the conference. He said that the Uttar Pradesh Assembly and the state have given many Prime Ministers to the country. This conference is an important platform for the introspection of Indian democracy. Pandey emphasized, "How can the journey from the platform of power to the temple of the people be made better? Democracy is not just about forming a government. It is the duty of the government to adhere to constitutional decorum. It is an institution of wisdom, not opposition." He reminded that the Constitution is greater than power and the people are supreme. Appealing to the presiding officers, he said that only when the ruling party and the opposition are viewed equally, does the House become a true temple of democracy. Pandey questioned the executive, stating that the House is run for fewer days than it should be. He urged that the sessions of the House be extended according to the rules, so that issues related to the public can be adequately discussed. He specifically appealed to Om Birla to deliberate on this matter at the conference. Need for innovation in legislature in line with changing times Rajya Sabha Deputy Chairman Harivansh, in his address, described the conference as a platform for lively dialogue among presiding officers. He praised Om Birla's efforts, due to which conferences of parliamentary committees are being held regularly. Harivansh highlighted the contributions of Satish Mahana, whom he had the opportunity to know for the past few years. He said, "Mahana has innovated. The capacity building of members is done by communicating with them in different groups. The vision document was discussed and the rules of the assembly have been prepared." Emphasizing the need for innovation in the legislature in line with changing times, Harivansh said that Uttar Pradesh is continuously progressing under the guidance of Prime Minister Modi and the leadership of Yogi Adityanath. Once considered a 'problem state', UP is now on the path of development. He proudly stated that this assembly has given four Bharat Ratnas to the country.

Separately, police registered FIRs against eight individuals for allegedly circulating misleading posts and photographs related to Manikarnika Ghat on social media. Those named include Aam Aadmi Party Rajya Sabha MP Sanjay Singh, Congress leader Pappu Yadav, and others. The administration has directed the accused to appear before the police within 72 hours to record their statements. Earlier in the day, members of the Pal community also raised slogans outside the Ahilyabai Holkar temple, demanding enhanced security for the temple and other heritage structures. First see the pictures... In a related development, FIRs were registered against eight people for allegedly circulating misleading content on social media. Those named include Aam Aadmi Party Rajya Sabha MP Sanjay Singh, Congress leader Pappu Yadav, and others. Police said some of the accused were also booked for allegedly using artificial intelligence tools to spread misinformation on social media platforms. All the accused have been directed to appear before the police within 72 hours to record their statements, failing which coercive action may follow. Meanwhile, Samajwadi Party president Akhilesh Yadav took a swipe at the ruling Bharatiya Janata Party, saying that BJP leaders would dismiss even visual evidence by claiming it was generated using artificial intelligence. The police said they were closely monitoring social media platforms and warned that strict action would be taken against those spreading rumours or provocative content that could disturb public order.

stories.title: Former IPS Amitabh Thakur gets bail:Deoria court says custody not necessary in land fraud case; wife Nutan Thakur’s relief denied
stories.summary: Former IPS officer Amitabh Thakur has been granted bail by a district court in Deoria in a fraud case linked to land registered in his wife’s name. He will be released once the bail warrant reaches the jail authorities. However, the court rejected the anticipatory bail plea of his wife, Nutan Thakur, in the same case. Thakur was arrested late on December 9 from Shahjahanpur railway station. Following his arrest, he went on a hunger strike in jail, alleging police misconduct, which led to a deterioration in his health. He was initially admitted to a hospital in Gorakhpur and later shifted to Lucknow’s PGI for further treatment. Court said - custody not necessary On Monday, the bail application filed by former IPS officer Amitabh Thakur was heard in Deoria court. His lawyer Praveen Dwivedi argued that this case is quite old. No criminal intent is proven in this. This matter is related to errors in documents, not any planned fraud. Meanwhile, the prosecution opposed the bail and emphasized the seriousness of the case. The District Judge passed an order granting bail to Amitabh Thakur. The court said - the accused has been in judicial custody for a long time. His continuous custody is not necessary for investigation. However, in the same case, the court rejected the anticipatory bail application of Amitabh's wife Nutan Thakur. This means it is now clear that Nutan Thakur will have to knock on the High Court's door for relief. Because if she doesn't do so, she can be arrested anytime. Now know the case in which the former IPS was arrested This land fraud case dates back to 1999, when Amitabh Thakur was posted as SP in Deoria. A plot in the industrial area of Deoria was purchased in the name of his wife Nutan Thakur. It is alleged that during the plot's registry, in the documents Nutan Thakur's name was recorded as Nutan Devi, while the husband's name was recorded as Abhijat instead of Amitabh Thakur. Based on these facts, the case was described as related to fraud and forgery. It is alleged that false information regarding name and identity was deliberately recorded in documents, which later led to legal disputes. However, this case remained dormant for years. But in September 2025, a case was registered at Talkatora police station in Lucknow. Police began the investigation. Considering Amitabh Thakur's role suspicious, he was made an accused. After this, on December 10, 2025, the police arrested Amitabh Thakur and sent him to Deoria jail. Read the complete script of the 26-year-old plot allotment case Forcibly Retired 7 Years Before Regular Retirement The words 'Forcefully Retired IPS' are written at Amitabh Thakur's residence. Actually, his retirement was due in 2028. However, he was caught in several departmental investigations during his service. On the recommendation of the state government, the Central Home Ministry gave him forced retirement. Due to the allegations, the central government had conducted a screening of IPS officer Amitabh Thakur's service. The screening report stated that Amitabh Thakur was not fit to remain in government service. After this, he put up a board outside his house - "Forcefully Retired IPS Amitabh Thakur". He later became active in politics and continued his confrontation with the government on several issues.

stories.title: CM Yogi orders action after Noida engineer’s death:3-member SIT formed under ADG Meerut, Noida Authority CEO sacked
stories.summary: The Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister, Yogi Adityanath, has taken cognisance of the death of a software engineer in Noida and ordered a high-level probe into the matter. The UP government has directed the formation of a three-member Special Investigation Team (SIT) to investigate the incident. The SIT will be headed by the Additional Director General (ADG), Meerut Zone, and will also include the Meerut Divisional Commissioner and the Chief Engineer of the Public Works Department (PWD). The team has been asked to submit its report to the Chief Minister within five days. In a major administrative action, Noida Authority CEO Lokesh M has been removed from his post. CEO removed, officials face action Prior to his removal, Lokesh M had issued show-cause notices to officials and staff responsible for basement construction and traffic-related work near an under-construction mall in Sector-150. He had also terminated the services of Noida Traffic Cell Junior Engineer Naveen Kumar with immediate effect. First, see 4 pictures... What happened: The incident On the night of January 16, around midnight, Yuvraj Mehta (27) was driving his Grand Vitara car to Tata Eureka Park in Sector-150, Noida. Due to dense fog, visibility was extremely poor. At the Sector-150 turn, which has a U-turn, Yuvraj could not see the road ahead. His car broke through a drain boundary and plunged into a water-filled pit in a vacant plot. The pit, about 30 feet deep, had been dug for the basement of a proposed mall. Trapped for over an hour Yuvraj managed to get out of the sinking car and climbed onto its roof. At around 12:20 am, he called his father and informed him about the accident. His father immediately alerted Dial-112 and rushed to the spot. Police and fire brigade teams arrived nearly 30 minutes later, followed by the SDRF team at around 1:15 am. Due to thick fog, only Yuvraj’s cries for help could be heard. For nearly 80 minutes, Yuvraj kept shouting for help, pleading to be rescued, warning that the car would soon sink. However, no immediate rescue could be carried out. Around 1:45 am, Yuvraj and his car were submerged completely into the water-filled pit. The NDRF team reached the spot from Ghaziabad at 1:55 am. His body was finally recovered at around 4:30 am. ‘No one was ready to enter the water’ A key eyewitness, Munendra, a delivery boy, said that he saw a crowd and police personnel at the site while making a night delivery. He noticed a young man using his mobile phone’s flashlight and shouting for help. “No one was ready to get into the water. Even the police said the water was extremely cold and there were iron rods inside,” Munendra said. He claimed that he tied a rope around his waist and attempted to enter the pit himself, but due to darkness and dense fog, visibility was almost zero. Victim’s family background Yuvraj Mehta was the only son of Rajkumar Mehta, a resident of Tata Eureka Park, Sector-150, and a retired Director from the State Bank of India (SBI). Yuvraj’s mother had passed away a few years ago after an illness. His elder sister is married and lives in the United Kingdom. Yuvraj worked as a software engineer with Dunnhumby India in Sector-54, Gurugram. Protests after the incident Following the incident, local residents staged protests at the site, blaming the Noida Authority’s negligence. Protesters said multiple accidents had occurred earlier at the same spot and that authorities had been repeatedly asked to install barricades and reflectors, but no action was taken. After the protests intensified, the authority dumped hundreds of tonnes of debris near the site late in the evening. Delay in rescue alleged The plot, identified as SC-02 in Sector-150, was vacant and earmarked for a mall project that never took off. The basement excavation had turned into a marsh due to water seepage from a nearby drain. Residents alleged that although the accident occurred around midnight and all teams were present, dense fog delayed effective rescue operations. Despite this, they claimed Yuvraj could have been saved if prompt and decisive action had been taken. FIR against builders Joint Commissioner of Police Rajeev Narayan Mishra said the incident occurred under the Knowledge Park police station area. Police and fire brigade teams reached the site immediately after receiving information and began rescue operations using ladders, cranes, and searchlights. The SDRF was later brought in for the final rescue amid zero visibility conditions. Based on a complaint by Yuvraj’s father, police have registered an FIR against two builders: Cause of death confirmed The post-mortem report has revealed that Yuvraj died due to asphyxiation. His lungs were filled with approximately 200 ml of water, indicating prolonged submersion. Doctors confirmed that suffocation due to water entering the lungs led to cardiac failure. Vehicle yet to be recovered Yuvraj’s car is still stuck inside the pit. Authorities said water will first be pumped out from the basement area, after which police will retrieve the vehicle.

stories.title: Former BJP MLA washes Kumar Vishwas’s feet:Aarti and floral welcome in Ayodhya; poet offers prayers to Ram Lalla
stories.summary: Poet Kumar Vishwas arrived in Ayodhya on Monday and offered prayers at the Ram Temple. He spent around 20 minutes admiring the temple’s grandeur. The Shri Ram Janmabhoomi Teerth Kshetra Trust welcomed him with an angavastram and prasad. At a local hotel, former BJP MLA Baba Gorakhnath washed Kumar Vishwas’s feet, applied tilak on his forehead, showered flowers and performed aarti. Speaking to the media, Kumar Vishwas said he was pleased with Ayodhya’s changing image. On Rahul Gandhi’s proposed visit to Ayodhya on January 23, he remarked, “It is God’s decision when and whom He calls to His door. Everyone is welcome.” Without naming Swami Avimukteshwaranand, Kumar Vishwas extended his best wishes to devotees arriving in Ayodhya after bathing at the Prayagraj Magh Mela. He urged the administration to maintain the dignity of saints and ensure proper arrangements for pilgrims. See 2 pictures... Those who please God are blessed with power: Kumar Vishwas Poet Kumar Vishwas on Monday said that those who win the Lord’s grace are also blessed with strength and authority. Speaking in Ayodhya, he said he felt a renewed sense of joy after receiving what he described as the Lord’s call to visit the holy city. “When the Lord came to Ayodhya, I received His command to come here. Earlier there was a sense of guilt in the mind, now the situation has changed,” Kumar Vishwas said. He praised the transformation of Ayodhya, pointing to improved infrastructure such as the airport, railway station and roads, and called it a period of cultural renaissance. Quoting episodes from the Ramayana, he said that those who keep the Lord in their hearts and dedicate themselves to His work are always favoured. “Be it Sugriva or Vibhishan, the Lord blesses those who serve Him with devotion and resolve,” he said. Before the ceremonial washing of his feet, Kumar Vishwas was welcomed with tilak, aarti and floral honours. Praise for Rajnath Singh Kumar Vishwas also praised Defence Minister Rajnath Singh, describing him as the Chancellor of the Atal Bihari School of Politics. “He speaks less, often through gestures, but always with meaning. As MP from Lucknow, he represents the legacy of Atal ji,” he said. Referring to Rajnath Singh’s recent remarks on Pakistan, Kumar Vishwas said India has an unfortunate neighbour with a long history of hostility. “Being alert and cautious is both India’s resolve and responsibility. The country is capable of giving a fitting response to any reckless act,” he added. ‘Ayodhya is already divine’ Speaking at the airport, Kumar Vishwas said Ayodhya was already divine. “I have seen one deity and now hope for a grand darshan of another,” he remarked. Sharing a personal note, he said he would turn 55 this Vasant Panchami and enter his 56th year. “I first came here at the age of 17 or 18. An entire era has passed since then. What people could not witness in 500–600 years, we have seen within this one year,” he said, recalling the long struggle, the suffering of kar sevaks and the eventual grand pran pratishtha of the Lord. On Rahul Gandhi’s Ayodhya visit Responding to a question on Rahul Gandhi’s proposed visit to Ayodhya on January 23, Kumar Vishwas said, “Oppose a party if you must, but do not oppose Ram. No one has ever prospered by opposing the Lord or harbouring hatred.” He added that it is God alone who decides who reaches His door and receives blessings. “Whether they come early or late, all are part of Him. My best wishes to leaders of both the ruling and opposition parties, and to all devotees coming for darshan,” Kumar Vishwas said.

stories.title: Prateek Yadav fell for Aparna's voice instantly:Met at a wedding, expressed love through emails, later distances grew after their love marriage
stories.summary: A family dispute involving Prateek Yadav, the step-brother of Samajwadi Party chief and former Chief Minister Akhilesh Yadav, has come into the open. Prateek has announced on Instagram that he is going to divorce his wife, Aparna Yadav. In his post, he made serious allegations against her. He said she ruined his family relations, wants fame and influence, and does not care about his mental health, which he said is very poor at present. After this public post, many questions have come up. People are asking why the issue came out suddenly. When and where did Prateek and Aparna first meet? How long after that did they get married? Who is more ambitious between the two? What is their relationship like with family members? Is there any outside interference in their marriage? How big a sign is a family matter appearing on Instagram? It is being reported that Prateek is currently out of the country. He also made this post from there. Such posts on social media have created a stir in political circles. Meanwhile, sources say that earlier, when Prateek had posted on social media, he was here at the time, and the post was deleted under pressure. But this time he is abroad, which is why the post has not been deleted yet. Although some people are calling it his account being hacked, neither Prateek nor Aparna has issued any clarification regarding this so far. Aparna and Prateek's meeting story is like a movie. Aparna and Prateek's love story is also like a movie script. Their first meeting took place in Lucknow in 2001 at an event. At that time, Aparna was only 1314 years old. Aparna was fond of singing, and when she sang at an event, Prateek was smitten by her. A few days later, Prateek and Aparna met at a wedding event, and they exchanged email IDs. Email ID because in that era there was neither mobile nor social media. In such a situation, the two started talking through email. This continued for a long time. A close friend of both, on condition of anonymity, said that Prateek had expressed his love for Aparna via email. In 2011, the marriage was fixed with the consent of both families. In 2012, the two got married with great pomp in Saifai. Aparna's entry into politics and then joining BJP Political experts say that Aparna Yadav has been an ambitious woman from the beginning. She had a passion for politics from the very beginning. After marriage, when the first assembly election was held in UP in 2017, Aparna Yadav contested from the Cantt assembly seat of Lucknow on a Samajwadi Party ticket. But in this election, she was defeated by BJP's Rita Bahuguna Joshi by a margin of 34 thousand. After this, when the 2022 election came, the SP announced that they would not give her a ticket. On this, Aparna joined the BJP. Mulayam Singh was not happy with Aparna's decision. The Samajwadi Party had said on Aparna joining the BJP that the BJP had taken Aparna into the party to use the Mulayam family. When Aparna joined BJP, she hoped to get a ticket, but she didn't get one. When the BJP government was formed again in the state, Aparna Yadav was made the Vice President of the Women's Commission. However, she was not happy with this post. But after meeting Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath, she assumed the position. Was BJP politics possible while remaining in the SP family? Political experts say that Mulayam's family is the largest political family in the state. Mulayam Singh was the founder of SP. From Mulayam's family, there are five MPs, two MLAs, and district panchayat members. All of them have won on the ticket of the Samajwadi Party. In such a situation, it was not easy for Aparna to do BJP politics while being in Mulayam's family. Despite this, Aparna has been attending programs held in Saifai from time to time. It's a different matter that after joining BJP in 2022, her importance in Mulayam's family had diminished. Prateek also distanced himself further from the Saifai family. The reason was that he was also held responsible for Aparna's move. Aparna was bothered by Prateek not achieving success like Akhilesh Prateek's close associates say that Prateek Yadav is the son of Mulayam's second wife, Sadhana Gupta. As such, Prateek never achieved the position in the Mulayam family that Akhilesh Yadav had. This bothered Aparna as well. Prateek never held any position. He had no connection with politics, nor any kind of interference. What is the reason for Prateek Yadav's silence and distance? Since Mulayam Singh Yadav's demise in October 2022, Prateek has rarely been seen in public places. He used to appear less in public places anyway. Prateek, a bodybuilding enthusiast, built his own gym in Gomtinagar and used to spend most of his time there. His pictures working out at the gym often go viral on social media. Is this divorce a personal consequence of that political rift? Many experts believe that Aparna's entry into BJP caused a rift in the family, which is now affecting their personal lives. Prateek has also accused Aparna of being an ambitious woman in his post. Looking at Aparna's career, this confirms it. Even when Akhilesh Yadav's government was in power in the state, she wanted to join the government. But Akhilesh Yadav did not give her the opportunity. When the 2017 elections took place, she insisted on a ticket. SP made her a candidate from Lucknow Cantt. She lost the election, and when the SP government was not formed, she turned to BJP in 2022. Even in BJP, when she received the post of Vice President of the Women's Commission, she expressed her displeasure. Being the daughter-in-law of the Mulayam family, she had hoped for a bigger position. What political message does she want to convey through her role as Vice President of the Women's Commission? Even in her role as the Vice-Chairperson of the Women's Commission, she wants to keep herself in the limelight. Recently, Aparna Yadav also jumped into the ongoing controversy over religious conversion at KGMU. wanted to meet the Vice-Chancellor, but the VC's chamber was closed. This led to a ruckus by her supporters. They tried to break the door, chanted slogans, and vandalized. Aparna held a press conference there and leveled serious allegations against the administration.

stories.summary: Bhaskar English brings you the biggest news from Uttar Pradesh and around the world. Here are the top news headlines of the day: 1. Supreme Court orders transparency in voter roll revision; EC told to publish discrepancy lists, issue receipts during SIR hearing The Supreme Court has directed the Election Commission to publicly disclose the list of voters flagged for “logical discrepancies” during the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls. The court ordered that the discrepancy list must be displayed publicly and that receipts must be issued whenever documents are accepted from individuals during hearings. 2. Rahul Gandhi gets final court warning in defamation case The Sultanpur MP/MLA court has ordered Congress leader Rahul Gandhi to appear in person on February 20 in a defamation case linked to remarks on Amit Shah. The court said this would be his last chance and warned of action if he fails to appear. 3. Shankaracharya Avimukteshwaranand begins 24-hour hunger strike at Magh Mela Jagadguru Shankaracharya Swami Avimukteshwaranand has started a 24-hour hunger strike at the Prayagraj Magh Mela after police stopped his palanquin procession. He spent the night protesting in the cold at the same spot where police halted him. 4. Nitin Nabin elected BJP national president unopposed BJP’s working president Nitin Nabin is set to become the national president. The nomination process began at party headquarters in the presence of Defence Minister Rajnath Singh, Home Minister Amit Shah, Union Ministers JP Nadda, Nitin Gadkari, and other senior leaders. All these leaders submitted letters of support for Nitin to the election officer. 5. Delhi High Court refuses to stay Kuldeep Sengar’s 10-year sentence The Delhi High Court has rejected former BJP MLA Kuldeep Singh Sengar’s plea seeking suspension of his sentence in the Unnao custodial death case. Sengar was sentenced to 10 years in prison for the death of the rape victim’s father while in police custody. 6. Prateek Yadav announces divorce from Aparna Yadav in Instagram post Akhilesh Yadav’s brother, Prateek Yadav, has announced his decision to divorce Aparna Yadav through a social media post. He accused her of ruining his family and harming his mental health. 7. Silver breaches ₹3 lakh per kg mark for 1st time Silver prices have breached the ₹3 lakh per kg mark for the first time ever in futures trade on the Multi-Commodity Exchange (MCX) on Monday, January 19, 2026. This rate has been recorded for the futures contract of the white metal having an expiry of March 05, 2026. 8. Karni Sena files complaint against cricketer Rinku Singh over AI video Karni Sena has lodged a police complaint against KKR cricketer Rinku Singh for sharing an AI-generated video depicting Lord Hanuman driving a car. The video, shared on Facebook, triggered outrage and allegations of hurting religious sentiments. 9. AIMIM’s Maharashtra gains may hurt SP’s prospects in UP AIMIM’s strong performance in Maharashtra local body elections has raised concerns for the Samajwadi Party ahead of UP polls. Political observers fear a split in Muslim votes could weaken Akhilesh Yadav’s party. 10. Final call on Bangladesh’s T20 World Cup participation to be taken on January 21 The ICC has asked the Bangladesh Cricket Board (BCB) to clarify by January 21 whether it will participate in the 2026 T20 World Cup and whether its team will come to India to play matches.

stories.title: CM Yogi both Deputy-CMs expected as Nitin Nabin’s proposers:Reach Delhi for BJP National President nomination; 20 from UP
stories.summary: BJP’s national president post is expected to be filled by Nitin Nabin. He will file his nomination for the 12th national president position at the BJP headquarters in Delhi today. From UP, his proposers include Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath, Deputy Chief Ministers Keshav Prasad Maurya and Brajesh Pathak, and former state president Bhupendra Chaudhary, among 20 prominent leaders. The BJP issued the notification for the national president election on 16 January. Nitin Nabin was appointed the party’s working president on 14 December 2025. Know Who the Proposers from UP Are From UP, the proposers include: A total of 20 leaders from UP have become proposers. CM Yogi, both Deputy CMs and other proposers have reached Delhi. Know the Complete Nomination Schedule Nominations for the BJP’s 12th national president post will be filed at the BJP headquarters in Delhi between 2 PM and 4 PM on Monday. The nomination papers will then be scrutinised from 4 PM to 5 PM. The withdrawal window will be open from 5 PM to 6 PM. If only one nomination is found valid, the election officer will declare the president unopposed. If two nominations are valid, voting will take place on the 20th. Know How the President Is Elected The BJP national president is elected by the National Council, which comprises around 5,708 members. This includes members of the National Council and all State Councils, representing more than 30 states across the country. However, if there is only one valid nomination, voting will not be required.

stories.title: 4 family members killed by crushing heads in Etah:Bodies of trader’s father, wife daughter found; investigation underway
stories.summary: Three members of a family were brutally murdered in broad daylight in UP’s Etah district, while a fourth woman was found critically injured and hospitalised. The victims include an elderly man, his daughter-in-law and his granddaughter. The mother-in-law was found critically injured and was admitted to hospital, where she later died. Gruesome scene inside house Police found two women lying on the floor and one person on a bed, all with severe head injuries. Blood was splattered across the room. A blood-stained interlocking brick was found at the spot, raising suspicion that the victims’ heads were crushed with it. Incident location The crime occurred in the Nagla Premi area, within the Kotwali Nagar police station limits. After receiving information, a large police force rushed to the scene and cordoned off the entire locality. Victims identified The deceased have been identified as: Ganga Singh’s wife, Shyama Devi (70), was found alive but in severe pain and was immediately rushed to hospital. Son’s account upon witnessing scene Kamal Singh, son of Ganga Singh, said he had returned home from his medical store about an hour earlier to have lunch and everything was normal at that time. After eating, he went back to his shop and later to the market. He said that when his son returned from school, he noticed the fan running in the room despite the cold weather. When there was no response from inside, he entered the room and found the horrifying scene. He screamed for help, alerting neighbours and police. Police action and investigation Additional Superintendent of Police Shwetabh Pandey reached the spot along with heavy police force. The forensic team, field unit and dog squad were also deployed. Evidence has been collected and the room has been sealed. Police are scanning CCTV cameras installed outside the house and in the surrounding area to identify the attackers. The incident has created fear and panic across the locality. Situation under control Senior police officials have assured that all angles are being investigated and teams have been formed to trace those responsible for the heinous crime.

stories.title: 10-year-old girl tortured inside CRPF campus, Noida:Child critically injured, starved, ribs and teeth broken; now battling for life on ventilator
stories.summary: In Greater Noida, a CRPF constable and his wife allegedly assaulted a 10-year-old girl and admitted her to a hospital in a critical condition. Even doctors were shocked after seeing the girl’s condition. She had deep wounds on her body, several ribs and teeth were broken, and her hemoglobin level was found to be just 1.9. The girl’s body bore several fresh and old injury marks, indicating prolonged abuse. Doctors then prepared a Medical Legal Case (MLC) and informed the police. The police registered an FIR on January 18. For investigation, the police reached the CRPF camp and questioned senior officers. After the allegations were found to be true, the police arrested the accused Commandant Tariq Anwar and his wife. The case pertains to Police Station Ecotech-3. The girl was living with Tariq and his wife Rimpa on the same campus. Injury explained as bathroom fall, abuse suspected after medical examination In the CRPF campus under Ecotech-3, Commandant GD Tariq Anwar lives with his wife Rimpa Khatoon in Block No. 60, Quarter No. 13. Both accused are residents of West Bengal. A 10-year-old niece from the wife’s side was also living with them, from whom they made do household work. Tariq had not taken any permission to keep the child in the CRPF campus. On January 15, Tariq admitted the girl for the first time to Sarvodaya Hospital. The girl was in a critical condition. She had serious injuries on her head, chest, and other parts of her body. When doctors questioned Tariq about the cause of the injuries, he claimed that the child had slipped in the bathroom. However, when doctors medically examined the girl, they found several old wounds, injuries, and marks on her body. The girl was not even in a condition to speak. Reports reveal severe abuse of 10-year-old girl Doctors suspected brutality against the child, after which a team at the hospital prepared a Medical Legal Case. In the report, doctors stated that the girl’s condition was extremely critical. She had deep injuries on several parts of her body. Her condition suggested that she had been kept hungry for several days. The accused made her do household chores, and if she failed to perform properly, she was subjected to physical torture. The girl’s hemoglobin level was only 1.9. She had dark circles under her eyes and swelling in her legs. She was brought to the hospital’s emergency ward with deep wounds and in an unconscious state. The girl is reportedly the daughter of Rimpa’s sister-in-law from her maternal side, whom they had brought to Noida claiming they would give her good upbringing. Child now admitted to Max Hospital Tariq did not admit the child to the CRPF hospital for initial treatment. When her condition worsened, she was admitted to Max Hospital in Sector 28, where she is currently on ventilator support. Based on the medical report, doctors lodged an FIR against Tariq at Police Station Ecotech-3. When the police team reached the CRPF campus for investigation, they questioned senior officers. A Major stated that Constable Tariq Anwar and his wife Rimpa Khatoon had kept a nearly 10-year-old girl at their residence without the permission of senior officers. They had brought her from West Bengal to do household work. The child is said to be a relative of Tariq’s wife Rimpa. Police arrest the accused When the police questioned Tariq Anwar regarding the matter, he failed to give satisfactory answers to his officers and the police. Following this, CRPF officials suspended Tariq. The police then took immediate action and arrested the accused constable Tariq Anwar and his wife Rimpa Khatoon. ADCP Central Noida Santosh Kumar said that after the complaint, a case was registered under Section 110 of the BNS. The accused couple has been arrested and further legal action is underway.

stories.title: Prayagraj Magh Mela chaos caught on CCTV:Shankaracharya’s chariot procession halted as supporters break barricades; police struggle to control surging crowd
stories.summary: CCTV footage has surfaced showing chaotic scenes during Shankaracharya Avimukteshwaranand’s chariot procession on Mauni Amavasya at the Prayagraj Magh Mela. The video shows police barricades placed along the procession route. As the chariot approached, an argument broke out between the Shankaracharya’s supporters and police personnel deployed at the spot. Moments later, supporters began pushing forward after breaking through the barricades. Shankaracharya Avimukteshwaranand, who was riding the chariot, also moved ahead as the crowd surged. The footage shows supporters pushing and jostling police officers while moving forward. When the situation spiralled out of control, police officers attempted to disperse the crowd and restore order. However, the supporters did not stop and continued advancing, knocking down barricades in the process. The CCTV clip captures the confusion and disorder that unfolded during the religious procession. Click on the photo above to watch the video.

stories.summary: Noida School Timing: नोएडा और ग्रेटर नोएडा में ठंड का असर लगातार बढ़ता जा रहा है। सुबह के वक्त घना कोहरा और तेज सर्द हवाएं लोगों की दिनचर्या को प्रभावित कर रही हैं। खासकर छोटे बच्चों के लिए यह मौसम परेशानी भरा हो सकता है। इसी को ध्यान में रखते हुए गौतमबुद्ध नगर प्रशासन ने स्कूलों की टाइमिंग में बदलाव करने का फैसला लिया है। जिला प्रशासन की ओर से जारी आदेश के मुताबिक, 19 जनवरी से जिले के सभी स्कूल सुबह 10 बजे खुलेंगे और दोपहर 3 बजे तक चलेंगे। पहले स्कूलों का संचालन सुबह 8 बजे से होता था, लेकिन मौजूदा मौसम को देखते हुए इसे फिलहाल टाल दिया गया है। यह व्यवस्था अगले आदेश तक लागू रहेगी।

stories.title: Rahul Gandhi given final court warning in defamation case:Sultanpur MP MLA court orders appearance on Feb 20 in matter linked to Amit Shah
stories.summary: The Sultanpur MP/MLA court has directed Congress leader Rahul Gandhi to appear in person on February 20 in a long-running defamation case. The court warned that this would be his final opportunity, failing which action would be taken. Court Issues Final Warning During the previous hearing, the court had instructed Rahul Gandhi to be present. However, his advocate, Kashi Shukla, informed the court that he could not appear as he was in Kerala. The court made it clear that his statement must now be recorded and no further exemptions would be granted. Defamation Case Linked to Amit Shah Remark The hearing on Monday was held in connection with a defamation case related to Rahul Gandhi allegedly calling Union Home Minister Amit Shah a “murderer”. On January 6, Justice Shubham Verma had fixed February 19 for recording Rahul Gandhi’s statement. The case has been pending since 2018. Rahul Gandhi last appeared before the court on July 26, 2024. Background of the Case The case dates back to October 2018, when BJP leader Vijay Mishra filed a defamation complaint in a Sultanpur court. The allegation relates to remarks made by Rahul Gandhi during the Karnataka Assembly election campaign in August 2018, when Amit Shah was the BJP president. The matter has seen multiple adjournments over the past five years. Non-Bailable Warrant and Surrender In December 2023, the court issued a non-bailable warrant against Rahul Gandhi for repeatedly failing to appear. Following this, he surrendered before the MP/MLA court on February 20, 2024. At that time, Rahul Gandhi told the court:“I am innocent. There is a political conspiracy against me. I deny all the allegations. These charges are meant to damage my image and that of my party.” The court granted him bail on two bonds of ₹25,000 each. Statement That Sparked the Controversy According to Santosh Pandey, lawyer for petitioner Vijay Mishra, Rahul Gandhi made the controversial statement on May 8, 2018, during a press conference in Bengaluru. Rahul Gandhi allegedly said:“Amit Shah is accused of murder. The Supreme Court itself mentioned this in the Loya case. Therefore, I do not believe Amit Shah has any credibility. The president of a party that talks about honesty and integrity is accused of murder.” Judge Loya Case Context Judge Brijmohan Harkishan Loya died in Nagpur in December 2014 while attending a wedding. At the time, he was hearing the high-profile Sohrabuddin Sheikh encounter case, in which Amit Shah was an accused. Judge Loya’s son later described the death as natural. The Supreme Court also dismissed petitions seeking an SIT probe, stating that the death was natural. Petitioner Claims Reputation Was Harmed Petitioner Vijay Mishra said Rahul Gandhi’s remarks hurt his sentiments as a BJP supporter and damaged his reputation in society. He presented Ramchandra and Anil Mishra as witnesses. As evidence, Mishra submitted video clips of Rahul Gandhi’s statements circulated on YouTube and other websites, claiming there was sufficient material to summon him to court. Charges and Possible Punishment Rahul Gandhi has been charged under Sections 499 and 500 of the Indian Penal Code. If convicted, Rahul Gandhi could face up to two years in prison. Earlier Loss of Parliamentary Membership Rahul Gandhi’s parliamentary membership was revoked on March 24, 2023, after a Surat court sentenced him to two years in another defamation case. At the time, he was the MP from Wayanad. However, after the sentence was suspended, his membership was later restored.

stories.title: High Court refuses to stay Kuldeep Sengar’s sentence:Was given 10 years imrpisonment in Unnao rape victim father’s custodial death
stories.summary: Former BJP MLA Kuldeep Singh Sengar has suffered a major setback after the Delhi High Court dismissed his petition seeking suspension of sentence in the custodial death case of the Unnao rape victim’s father. Sengar was sentenced by a trial court to 10 years of rigorous imprisonment along with a fine of ₹10 lakh for the death of the victim’s father in police custody. The High Court upheld the sentence, observing that no leniency can be shown in cases involving custodial death, especially when the deceased was the sole earning member of the family. Sengar's brother and five other accused also sentenced Sengar’s brother Atul Singh Sengar and five other accused were also sentenced to 10 years’ imprisonment in the same case. Challenging this verdict, Sengar had approached the High Court seeking relief, which has now been denied. Earlier bail sparked outrage Earlier, the Delhi High Court had granted bail to Kuldeep Singh Sengar, who is already serving life imprisonment in the Unnao rape case. The decision triggered widespread outrage, with the victim’s family and several social organisations staging protests outside the Delhi High Court. Subsequently, the Supreme Court stayed the High Court’s bail order. Background of the case The case dates back to 2018, when the Unnao rape victim’s father was arrested on charges of illegal possession of weapons and sent to jail. His health deteriorated while in custody, and he later died. The victim’s family alleged that his death was not natural but the result of custodial torture carried out as part of a conspiracy. They claimed that the victim’s father was subjected to torture under the influence and pressure of Kuldeep Singh Sengar. Given the seriousness of the allegations, the investigation was handed over to the CBI. After a detailed probe, the CBI filed a chargesheet against Sengar and the other accused. Following prolonged hearings, the trial court convicted them and awarded the sentence. Court stresses need for strict action While rejecting Sengar’s plea, the Delhi High Court said the case was extremely serious and involved misuse of law by an influential individual. The court underlined the need to take a strict approach to ensure justice for the victim and her family. The High Court ruled that the grounds cited for suspension of sentence were insufficient and made it clear that Sengar was not entitled to any relief.

stories.title: PR obsession leads to murder of Punjab woman:UP youth stabbed her in Canada, escaped to India, later threatened family and arrested
stories.summary: A young woman from Sangrur in Punjab, who had moved to Canada in the hope of giving her family a better life, was allegedly murdered by a friend who wanted to forcibly marry her for permanent residency (PR). The woman was a permanent resident of Canada, while the accused, a youth from Uttar Pradesh, was seeking PR through marriage. After committing the murder, the accused fled to India before Canadian authorities could trace his involvement. Once his name surfaced in the murder investigation, he allegedly began threatening the victim’s family through social media. When the family refused to withdraw from pursuing the case, he allegedly travelled to their home in Sangrur with weapons to intimidate them. Sangrur police later registered a case against him for issuing threats online. When he again came to Sangrur to threaten the family, police arrested him, bringing the full sequence of events to light. Canadian police have declared the accused, Manpreet Singh, wanted in the murder case. From Sangrur to Canada and the murder of Amanpreet How Amanpreet’s murder came to light On her father’s request, Gursimran began searching for Amanpreet. During this period, Niagara police received a call reporting that the blood-soaked body of an Indian woman was lying in a deserted park near the Niagara River in the Lincoln area of Ontario. Police found multiple stab wounds on the body, including a deep wound to the neck, where the knife had pierced through, causing instant death. Photographs were circulated for identification, confirming the victim as Amanpreet. Sangrur SSP Sartaj Chahal shared details of the murder during a press conference. Why Amanpreet was murdered, how it was done and how the accused reached India Reached Sangrur to threaten the family after seeing legal action Sangrur SSP Sartaj Chahal said that after returning to India, Manpreet allegedly began threatening Amanpreet’s family through WhatsApp and Instagram. Towards the end of October 2025, he allegedly entered Inderjit’s house with weapons and threatened the family to withdraw the murder case in Canada. Following this, the family installed CCTV cameras outside their home. Police said Manpreet was captured on CCTV footage on 30 November 2025 and again on 10 January 2026. He also allegedly created a fake Instagram account to spread obscene comments and images. Sangrur police arrest reveals full story SSP Sartaj Chahal said that based on Inderjit’s complaint, a case was registered against Manpreet at the Cyber Crime Police Station in Sangrur on 14 January. He was arrested on 15 January in connection with cybercrime offences. A murder case is already registered against him in Canada, and he remains wanted by Canadian police. Police said formal communication is underway with Canadian authorities. If Canada seeks his custody for questioning, further action will be taken in accordance with Indian law.

stories.title: Husband arranges wife’s marriage to lover in Pratapgarh:Panchayat takes decision after affair exposed; children tell mother to forget them after leaving father
stories.summary: A rare and emotional incident from Pratapgarh has drawn wide attention. After ten years of marriage, a husband agreed to get his wife married to her lover following a village panchayat. The wedding took place in a temple, in front of the husband, villagers and the couple’s children. However, the children refused to go with their mother after the marriage. Incident in Pratapgarh village The case is from Ramgarha village in the Aaspur Devsara police station area of Pratapgarh district. The husband, Ashish Tiwari, caught his wife Pinky with her lover Amit Sharma in a compromising position on Saturday night. Ashish immediately informed the police. Police reached the spot and took Amit Sharma to the police station. After this, a panchayat was held outside the police station and later in the village. The discussions continued for several hours. Wife stood firm on her decision During the panchayat, Pinky clearly stated that she no longer wanted to live with her husband. She said she wished to spend her life with her lover Amit Sharma. Villagers and family members tried repeatedly to persuade her to change her mind, but she refused. Even Amit Sharma’s father opposed the relationship. He told Pinky that his son was addicted to drugs, did not work and would not be able to support her. Despite these warnings, Pinky remained firm. Husband agreed after panchayat consent Ashish Tiwari said he tried many times to explain things to his wife, but she did not listen. He told the panchayat that daily quarrels had made life difficult. After discussions and with the consent of the village council, Ashish agreed to get his wife married to her lover. He said it was better to arrange the marriage than to continue with constant disputes in the family. Temple wedding in front of villagers The marriage was solemnised at an ancient Shiva temple in Amargarh village. Pinky married Amit Sharma, who is a resident of Misiddhipur village. Many villagers and family members from both sides were present. During the ceremony, Amit filled Pinky’s hairline with vermilion in front of her husband and children. Pinky also touched her lover’s feet as a mark of respect during the wedding. Children refused to go with their mother After the marriage, Pinky asked her two sons to come with her. Both children refused. They told her that she had left their father and they did not want to stay with her. The children chose to remain with their father. Marriage details and family background Ashish Tiwari said that he and Pinky were married in 2016. They have two sons. The elder son is seven years old, and the younger son is four. A divorce case between Ashish and Pinky is already pending in court. Police statement Circle Officer Manoj Kumar Singh Raghuvanshi said the woman is an adult and free to take her own decisions. He clarified that the police did not force anyone. According to him, the decision was taken after mutual discussion during the panchayat, and the police had no direct role in the marriage. Village reacts with mixed emotions The incident has left the village shocked. While some villagers supported the panchayat’s decision to avoid further conflict, others were saddened by the impact on the children and the breakdown of a ten-year marriage.

stories.title: Akhilesh calls Shankaracharya Avimukteshwaranand:Says, ‘I will meet you soon’; stopped by police in Prayagraj on Jan 18 during visit attempt
stories.summary: Samajwadi Party chief Akhilesh Yadav spoke on the phone with Shankaracharya Swami Avimukteshwaranand, who is sitting on a protest at the Prayagraj Magh Mela. Yadav told him that he would come to meet him soon and said he stood with him. The Shankaracharya said that when a child is born into Hinduism, they automatically get the right to bathe in the Ganga and Yamuna, but even this right had been taken away from him. Political support extended The Shankaracharya is sitting on a dharna at the same place where the police had dropped him, protesting against the stopping of his palanquin or chariot procession. He spent the entire night sitting in the cold inside his pandal. Hunger strike continues He has not eaten a single grain of food for the past 28 hours and has even stopped drinking water as part of his protest. Administration asked apology On Monday afternoon, the Shankaracharya held a press conference. He said that until the administration comes and apologises, he will not enter his ashram and will stay on the pavement. He said that whenever Shankaracharyas have gone for ritual bathing in history, they have gone in a palanquin. He took a vow that he would come to Prayagraj for every mela, but would never stay in a camp and would make arrangements only on the pavement. CCTV footage surfaces Earlier, media in-charge Shailendra Yogiraj said that the Shankaracharya has not eaten anything since yesterday and no administrative officer has come to meet him. He performed his morning prayers and ritual offerings at the same spot. Meanwhile, CCTV footage of the chaos during the Shankaracharya’s chariot procession on Mauni Amavasya has surfaced. The video shows that the police had put up barricades on the road, after which an argument broke out between the Shankaracharya’s supporters and the police. The supporters then broke the barricades and started moving ahead. 45.2 million devotees take holy dip Meanwhile, on the occasion of Mauni Amavasya, a record 45.2 million devotees took a holy dip. Based on this figure, Prayagraj became the world’s most populous city for the day on Sunday. According to recent estimates, the world’s most populous city is Indonesia’s capital Jakarta, with a population of around 40 million.

stories.title: Rahul Gandhi's 2-day Raebareli visit starts today:LoP to hold meetings with farmers-laborers in village, will inaugurate cricket tournament
stories.summary: Leader of Opposition in Lok Sabha and Raebareli MP Rahul Gandhi is arriving on a two-day tour of his parliamentary constituency from Monday. This is his first such visit after winning the election, where he will go village to village and sit among the public to hear their problems. He will particularly have direct dialogue through meetings with farmers and MGNREGA workers. This visit is also important because panchayat elections are near and Congress is strongly opposing the center's new policy on the MGNREGA scheme. On Monday evening, Rahul Gandhi will depart from Lucknow airport by road and reach Bhuemau Guest House at 9:15 PM. He will stay there for the night. Robust security arrangements have been made for the tour. A CRPF team from Delhi has inspected all program venues. Here is the complete program- Hearing in defamation case in MP-MLA court of Sultanpur A hearing is also scheduled in Sultanpur's MP/MLA court on Monday in a defamation case related to Rahul Gandhi. This hearing is related to the defamation case for calling Union Home Minister Amit Shah a 'murderer' during the Karnataka Assembly elections. According to plaintiff Vijay Mishra's lawyer Santosh Pandey, in the previous hearing, the cross-examination of witness Ramchandra Dubey by the defense side was completed. After this, Justice Shubham Verma set the date for January 6 and ordered Rahul Gandhi to appear personally on January 19 to record his statement under Section 313 of the CrPC. In this case, ongoing since 2018, Rahul Gandhi last appeared in court on July 26, 2024. This case against Rahul is related to an alleged derogatory remark made against Amit Shah in Karnataka 7 years ago. During the 2018 Karnataka elections, Rahul had said that the party that talks about honesty has a president who is accused of murder. After this, BJP leader Vijay Mishra from Sultanpur filed a defamation case against Rahul on August 4, 2018.

stories.title: Fatal crash on Delhi–Lucknow Highway 24:Car caught between speeding trucks leaves child and man dead, three critically injured on Friday night
stories.summary: A horrific road accident on Delhi–Lucknow Highway 24 on Friday turned a journey filled with happiness into mourning. A car trapped between two speeding trucks resulted in the death of a child and one adult on the spot, while two elderly women and another person were seriously injured. As soon as information about the accident was received, the Civil Lines police station inspector and police personnel reached the spot. A fire brigade team also worked for nearly an hour to rescue people trapped inside the car. All the injured were sent to the district hospital by ambulance, where treatment was initiated. Deaths confirmed at hospital During treatment at the district hospital, Additional Superintendent of Police Anurag Singh said that there were a total of five people travelling in the car. They were identified as Nutan (56), wife of Samarjit; Surya Pratap (30), son of Samarjit; Girish Kumari, wife of Ravindra Singh; Ritik Arora (45), son of Amit Arora; and Yatharth (3), son of Amit. Doctors declared Yatharth and Ritik Arora dead, while treatment of the seriously injured is continuing.​​​​​​​ Victims from Aligarh and Moradabad Additional SP Anurag Singh said that all the occupants of the car were residents of Aligarh and were travelling from Rudrapur to Aligarh. One of the deceased had taken a lift from Moradabad and also lost his life in the accident.

stories.title: Constable stops former IG during Mauni Amavasya checks:KP Singh says, 'I also managed Kumbh in 2019'; official was allowed to move forward after senior cop intervened
stories.summary: A routine security check during Mauni Amavasya at the Prayagraj Maha Kumbh led to an unusual situation when a police constable stopped former Uttar Pradesh Police Inspector General Kavindra Pratap Singh at a barricade, despite him identifying himself. The incident underlined the strict enforcement of crowd-control measures during the mega religious event. First see 2 pictures... Stopped Despite Identity Disclosure KP Singh, currently President of the Vishwa Hindu Parishad (Kashi Province), was heading to the VHP camp at around 11 am in his Innova car. Police first stopped the vehicle at the Daraganj barricade near Alopi Temple. Singh remained seated while his driver informed the police about his identity. After a brief discussion, the vehicle was allowed to move forward. However, about 500 metres ahead, the car was stopped again at a barricade under Shastri Bridge. This time, the on-duty constable refused to allow passage, saying no one would be permitted beyond the point. When informed, Singh stepped out of the car and personally introduced himself, but the constable remained firm. Barricade Removed After Senior Officers Intervene The situation eased only after senior police personnel reached the spot and recognised the former IG. Following this, the barricade was removed and Singh was allowed to proceed on foot. As he left, the constable reportedly saluted him. Commenting on the incident later, KP Singh said the police were only performing their duty and such situations were inevitable due to heavy crowds on Mauni Amavasya. Key Role in Previous Kumbh Arrangements A native of Mirzapur, KP Singh is a 1987-batch PPS officer who was promoted to the IPS in 2002. He earned praise for his role in organising the 2012–13 Kumbh and was later given charge of the 2019 Kumbh Mela, which was widely regarded as successfully managed. After retirement, Singh has been serving as President of the Vishwa Hindu Parishad (Kashi Province) for the past two years. During his 34-year career, he spent nearly 18 years posted in Prayagraj and is known for his approachable nature and popularity among the public.

stories.title: Akhilesh Yadav’s step-brother announces separation from wife Aparna Yadav:Alleges wife ruined family, damaged his mental health; makes controversial Instagram post
stories.summary: Akhilesh Yadav's brother, Prateek Yadav, will divorce Aparna Yadav. He posted on Instagram - A selfish woman has ruined my family. She has deteriorated my mental state. Prateek Yadav shared a post from his official Instagram account, iamprateekyadav, stating that he is going to get divorced as soon as possible. In the post, he clearly stated that he wants to separate from "this selfish woman." 'Aparna Yadav's behavior is insensitive towards family...' His relationships with his family have deteriorated because of his wife. After marriage, tension in family relationships continued to increase, which affected his personal and social life. According to Prateek, his wife's behavior has been insensitive towards the family. Got married in 2011, has 2 daughters Prateek and Aparna were married in 2011 and have two daughters. Their wedding ceremony was attended by Mulayam Singh Yadav as well as Bollywood megastar Amitabh Bachchan. Prateek was also present with Aparna on her birthday on December 4, 2025. Who is Aparna Yadav? Aparna Yadav is the younger daughter-in-law of Mulayam Singh Yadav. She joined the BJP ahead of the 2022 Assembly elections. During the 2022 polls, she had sought a BJP ticket from Lucknow’s Sarojini Nagar seat but was not nominated. Aparna is married to Prateek Yadav, the son of Mulayam Singh Yadav and his second wife, Sadhna Yadav. Aparna Yadav was born on January 1, 1990. Her father, Arvind Singh Bisht, worked with a media company and also served as an Information Commissioner during the Samajwadi Party government. Her mother, Ambi Bisht, is an officer. Aparna completed her schooling at Loreto Convent, Lucknow. Prateek Yadav celebrated Aparna Yadav’s birthday on December 4, 2025. Who is Prateek Yadav? Prateek Yadav is the son of late Mulayam Singh Yadav and his second wife, Sadhna Gupta. He has completed his higher education abroad, in the UK. Belonging to one of the state’s most prominent political families, Prateek Yadav is associated with the real estate and fitness business sectors. He owns a gym in Lucknow named The Fitness Planet. Prateek Yadav also runs an animal welfare organisation called Jeev Aashray, which works for the treatment, care, feeding, and rescue of street dogs.

stories.title: Karni Sena files complaint against Rinku Singh over ‘jihadi mentality’:Hanuman depicted driving a car in AI-generated video shared by KKR cricketer
stories.summary: Cricketer Rinku Singh has landed in a new controversy by sharing an AI video of God on Facebook. Karni Sena has filed a complaint against Rinku at the police station in Aligarh. Actually, Rinku Singh had shared such a video from his Facebook account, in which God was shown in an AI avatar. In the video, Rinku is seen hitting shots on the cricket field. The caption reads - "Who made you a cricketer?" In the next footage, Lord Shiva, Hanuman, Vishnu, and Ganesha are seen sitting in a Thar car. All of them are wearing black glasses. Bajrangbali is driving the car. English songs are playing in the background. A debate has erupted on social media regarding the video. Some people say that Rinku's intentions were good and there is nothing wrong with it. However, some people are calling it an act that tampers with religious sentiments. As soon as the video went viral, Karni Sena got agitated. District President Sumit Tomar, along with workers, reached the Sasni Gate police station on Sunday and filed a complaint against Rinku Singh. He said - "Rinku Singh has shown his ‘jihadi’ mentality just like Shah Rukh Khan." Karni Sena District President said - Insult to Sanatan Dharma Karni Sena District President Sumit Tomar said, "Rinku Singh is a part of Shah Rukh Khan's IPL team, Kolkata Knight Riders. Like Shah Rukh, Rinku has revealed his true mentality. Making our God wear black glasses, driving him in a Thar, and showing him dancing to English songs is playing with faith." He said, "Karni Sena will not tolerate this. Rinku Singh should publicly apologise to Sanatan Dharma with folded hands. The administration should immediately file an FIR against Rinku Singh. If no action is taken, the organisation will take to the streets and launch a major agitation." Police station in-charge said, 'The authenticity of the video will be investigated' In this regard, Sasni Gate Police Station In-charge said- Karni Sena has submitted a complaint. This matter will be investigated. Legal action will be taken only after verifying the authenticity of the video and investigating the person who posted it. Rinku got engaged to SP MP Priya Saroj Cricketer Rinku Singh and SP MP Priya Saroj had their ring ceremony on June 8 at 'The Centrum' hotel in Lucknow. It was attended by 300 VIP guests including Akhilesh Yadav, Dimple Yadav, Jaya Bachchan, Shivpal Yadav, and Iqra Hasan. During the ring ceremony, when Rinku put the ring on Priya's finger on the stage, she became emotional and burst into tears. Rinku consoled her. After the ceremony, both cut a cake and fed it to each other. Rinku and Priya danced a lot with the guests and family members. Wedding date postponed, date not finalized yet Cricketer Rinku Singh and MP Priya Saroj were scheduled to get married in Kashi on November 18. However, the wedding date has been postponed. It is likely that the wedding may take place three months later, in February 2026. However, the new date has not been fixed yet. Priya's MLA father, Toofani Saroj, had stated that the wedding date was postponed due to Rinku's engagement in domestic cricket. Rinku will be playing domestic cricket for the state team until February 2024. After this, Rinku and Priya will get married.
